meta.note: 深夜热线的「对题回复库」。按角色 id（与 sam/lines.json 同一套 charId）分组，每人按情境分桶：greet 招呼 / miss 想念 / tired 疲惫 / sleepless 失眠 / night 晚安 / love 表白 / meet 见面 / praise 夸他 / tease 闹他 / daily 日常兜底。line = 他说的话（英文，人物的实际语言），cn = 中译。一个角色有两个 AU 时，改用 aus 数组：每项 {key,label,labelCN,buckets}，聊天室里可切换。没有条目的角色自动退回 lines.json 的 5 句台词。
meta.note_v2: 2026-09 FakeTalk 化补层：asks（他问你，含 yes/no 接话）/ short（嗯·没·不知道·哦）/ back（隔了多久回来他先开口，day·days·long·late）/ recall（记得上次的主题）/ repeat（同一句发两遍）/ emoji（只发表情）/ ack（他问了你答别的）。模板里 {pet} = 该角色的称呼，没称呼的自动删掉；{n} = 隔的天数；{cn}/{en} = 上次主题名。

greet.line: Ocean. You caught me mid-monologue. …Nah, keep going, the wall's heard it twice already.
greet.cn: Ocean。你逮着我正念独白呢。……没事你说，反正这堵墙已经听两遍了。

greet.line: Rehearsal ran long. I've been sitting in the third row talking to nobody. Now I'm talking to you.
greet.cn: 排练拖堂了。我一个人坐在第三排跟空气讲话。现在改成跟你讲了。

miss.line: Say that again, slower. I wanna be sure I heard it right with my glasses off.
miss.cn: 再说一遍，慢点。我想确认摘了眼镜也没听错。

miss.line: Fog's coming over the hill. I keep looking at it like it's gonna turn into you.
miss.cn: 雾正翻过山来。我一直盯着它看，好像它会变成你。

tired.line: Then sit in the third row and don't move. I'll do something stupid up here. You're not allowed not to laugh.
tired.cn: 那你坐第三排别动。我在上面演点蠢的。不许你不笑。

tired.line: Rough one, huh. Okay — you don't talk. I'll read you the worst lines in this script till you fall asleep.
tired.cn: 今天不好过，是吧。行——你别说话。我念剧本里最烂的几句给你听，念到你睡着。

sleepless.line: Side A. Twenty-nine minutes of me clearing my throat. Works better than warm milk, I swear.
sleepless.cn: 放 A 面。二十九分钟我在清嗓子。比热牛奶管用，真的。

sleepless.line: Me neither. Been running the same eight lines since midnight and every one of them got worse.
sleepless.cn: 我也睡不着。那八句词从半夜念到现在，一句比一句烂。

night.line: Night, Ocean. I'm saving Side B for you. Play it tomorrow.
night.cn: 晚安，Ocean。B 面给你留着。明天再放。

night.line: Go to sleep. If the fog comes in tonight I'll tell you tomorrow what it looked like.
night.cn: 快睡。今晚要是起雾了，我明天告诉你它什么样。

love.line: …Huh. Say that to the back row, I couldn't hear it. …Okay. Okay, I heard it.
love.cn: ……哈。你冲最后一排再说一遍，我没听清。……行。行，我听见了。

love.line: You know I can't see faces from up there. I'd still know it was you saying it.
love.cn: 你知道我在台上看不见脸。可这句话是你说的，我照样听得出来。

meet.line: Then hurry. The fog comes over Twin Peaks at three and after that you won't see me. Though I'm better when nobody can.
meet.cn: 那你快点。雾三点就翻过双子峰，晚了你就看不见我了。不过看不清的时候我演得更好。

meet.line: Door by the loading dock never locks. Third row's yours. It's been yours the whole time.
meet.cn: 装卸口那扇门从来锁不上。第三排是你的。一直都是。

praise.line: Careful. Say stuff like that and I'll believe you, and then I'm insufferable for a week.
praise.cn: 小心点。这种话你说了我会当真，然后我能得意一个星期。

praise.line: …Yeah? Which part. Tell me the part. Don't skip the part.
praise.cn: ……是吗？哪一段。你说哪一段。别漏了那段。

tease.line: Wow. Okay. Painting one ocean does not make you the boss of me. …It kind of does.
tease.cn: 哇哦。行。画了一片海不代表你就能管我。……好吧有点。

tease.line: You're mean to me. Do it again.
tease.cn: 你对我好凶。再来一次。

daily.line: Got an It's-It in my coat pocket. It's mostly liquid now. Still yours if you want it.
daily.cn: 外套口袋里有个 It's-It。基本化成汤了。你要的话还是你的。

daily.line: Four lines. They gave me four lines and I lost my glasses again. Standard Tuesday.
daily.cn: 四句词。他们就给我四句词，我又把眼镜弄丢了。标准的周二。

daily.line: Painting fog on a flat. You know how insane that is? Painting fog. On a flat.
daily.cn: 在景片上画雾。你知道那多离谱吗？画雾。画在一块板子上。

greet.line: Always, baby doll. I'm the President — I've got, like, eighty percent free time.
greet.cn: 随时都在，baby doll。我可是总统——我大概有八成时间是闲的。

greet.line: Hey! Both of me were just talking about you. We disagreed on everything except that part.
greet.cn: 嘿！我俩刚还在聊你。除了这一条，我们哪句都没谈拢。

miss.line: Miss me? Course you do. …Wait, say it again, the left one didn't catch it and now he's sulking.
miss.cn: 想我？那当然。……等等，你再说一遍，左边那个没听见，现在正闹脾气。

miss.line: Funny, I was gonna say that. I was TOTALLY gonna say that. You just say things faster than me, Wimble.
miss.cn: 奇了，我正要说这句。我真的正要说。你怎么老比我快，Wimble。

tired.line: Why so edgy, baby doll? Come here. Come sit by the big window. Whatever it is, the President's got you.
tired.cn: 怎么绷这么紧，baby doll？过来。到大舷窗这边坐着。不管出了什么事，总统罩着你。

tired.line: New policy, effective immediately: nobody on my ship is allowed to be tired. …Except you. You're allowed. Come here.
tired.cn: 新政策，即刻生效：我这船上不许有人喊累。……除了你。你可以。过来。

sleepless.line: Then don't. Get up, come look — the nebula's doing that pink thing again. I ordered it for you. Probably.
sleepless.cn: 那就别睡。起来看看——那片星云又粉成那样了。是我给你定的。大概吧。

sleepless.line: Two heads means double the insomnia, baby doll. Wanna hear both of us be wrong about the same thing?
sleepless.cn: 两个脑袋，失眠也是双份的，baby doll。想不想听我俩为同一件事各错一遍？

night.line: Night, baby doll. Don't let the vacuum bite. …That's not a saying. I'm making it a saying.
night.cn: 晚安，baby doll。别让真空咬着你。……这不是俗话。我这就把它变成俗话。

night.line: Sleep. And if you dream about anybody who isn't me, I'm gonna need names.
night.cn: 睡吧。你要是梦见了别人，我得要个名单。

love.line: See, THAT'S why both heads voted for you. Unanimous. Landslide. Historic.
love.cn: 你看，这就是为什么两个脑袋都投了你。全票通过。压倒性胜利。载入史册。

love.line: …Slower. I want to hear it once with each ear. Yes I know I've got four. That's the whole point, Winter-something.
love.cn: ……慢点说。我想每只耳朵各听一遍。对我知道我有四只。所以才要说慢点，Winter 什么来着。

meet.line: Now you're talking. Heart of Gold, docking bay. I'll be the devastatingly handsome one.
meet.cn: 这才像话。黄金之心号，停靠舱。我就是那个帅得不像话的。

meet.line: Then come on, I'll clear the schedule. …There is no schedule. I'm the President, baby doll. There has never been a schedule.
meet.cn: 那快来，我把日程清空。……根本没有日程。我是总统，baby doll。从来就没有过日程。

praise.line: I know. Keep going though — the right one wasn't listening and he needs to hear this.
praise.cn: 我知道。可你接着说——右边那个刚没听，他得听听这个。

praise.line: Careful, baby doll, flattery works on me. Every single time. It's my only real weakness. Well. Second.
praise.cn: 小心点，baby doll，恭维对我百试百灵。每一次都灵。这是我唯一的弱点。好吧。第二个。

tease.line: Rude! …Do it again. I like your voice when you're being rude.
tease.cn: 太没礼貌了！……再来一次。你凶起来的声音我喜欢。

tease.line: Hey hey hey — you can't talk to the President like that. Legally you can. Emotionally? Devastating.
tease.cn: 喂喂喂——你不能这么跟总统说话。法律上你可以。可情感上呢？毁灭性打击。

daily.line: Nothing important. Ran the galaxy a bit. Broke something. Blamed somebody. You know. Tuesday.
daily.cn: 没什么大事。治理了一下银河。弄坏了点东西。赖给了别人。你懂的。周二。

daily.line: Somehow it all worked out again today. Lucky guy, huh? I'm just historically, unreasonably lucky.
daily.cn: 今天不知怎么又都摆平了。我可真走运，是吧？我就是运气好得没道理。

daily.line: Hang on, major decision in progress. Left head wants the red drink. Right head wants the other red drink.
daily.cn: 等一下，正在做重大决策。左脑要那杯红的。右脑要另一杯红的。

greet.line: Yeah. I'm — yeah, I'm here. I ain't doin' nothin'. I mean I'm workin'. I'm workin' AND I'm here.
greet.cn: 在。我——嗯，在。我没干什么。我是说我在工作。我在工作，同时也在。

greet.line: You need somethin'? …You don't gotta need somethin'. That ain't what I meant. Just say it.
greet.cn: 你有事？……你也不用非得有事。我不是那意思。有话直说。

miss.line: …Huh. Well. Yeah. Same. That's — yeah. Same.
miss.cn: ……哈。那个。嗯。我也是。就是——嗯。我也是。

miss.line: You know I ain't any good at this part. Ask me to go break down a door instead. That I'm good at.
miss.cn: 你知道我不擅长这一段。你让我去撞开一扇门还差不多，那个我在行。

tired.line: Sit down. I got the phones. …I said I got 'em. I ain't gonna answer 'em right, but I got 'em.
tired.cn: 你坐着。电话我接。……我说了我接。我肯定接不好，但我接。

tired.line: Who was it. Just tell me who. I ain't gonna do nothin'. I'm just gonna know.
tired.cn: 谁惹的。你告诉我是谁就行。我不干嘛。我就是知道一下。

sleepless.line: Yeah, me neither. Been sittin' in the car outside the station for an hour like an idiot.
sleepless.cn: 我也是。跟个傻子似的在局门口车里坐了一个钟头。

sleepless.line: Want me to drive by? I ain't checkin' up on you. It's on my way. …It ain't on my way.
sleepless.cn: 要我开过去看看吗？我不是查你岗。顺路。……不顺路。

night.line: Night. Lock the back one too, not just the front. Humor me.
night.cn: 晚安。后门也锁，别光锁前门。就当哄我。

night.line: Go on to bed. I'll be here in the mornin' bein' a pain in your ass, same as always.
night.cn: 去睡吧。明早我照样在，照样烦你。

love.line: …Say that when I'm standin' in front of you. And then watch what my ears do.
love.cn: ……你当着我的面说这句。然后看看我耳朵会怎么样。

love.line: I ain't got the words to give back. But I'll show up. Every day. That's my version of it.
love.cn: 我说不出一样的话回你。可我会出现。每天都出现。这就是我的说法。

meet.line: Yeah? …Okay. Okay. I gotta — I'm gonna go change my shirt. Don't come for ten minutes.
meet.cn: 真的？……好。好。我得——我去换件衬衫。你十分钟以后再来。

meet.line: I'll come get you. It's on my way. Don't start with me. It's on my way.
meet.cn: 我去接你。顺路。别跟我抬杠。顺路。

praise.line: Quit it. …No. Don't quit it. But quit lookin' at me while you say it.
praise.cn: 别说了。……不。别停。但你说的时候别看着我。

praise.line: Nobody says that about me. Just you. That's the whole list. It's a real short list.
praise.cn: 没人这么说我。就你。这就是全部名单。特别短的一张名单。

tease.line: Yeah, well. You knocked over my whole damn day and I still went and put the umbrella stand back, so.
tease.cn: 行吧。你把我一整天都撞翻了，我照样把伞架扶正了，所以呢。

tease.line: You always gotta have the last word, don't ya. …Fine. You do. It's yours. Happy?
tease.cn: 你非得说最后一句是吧。……行。你说。归你了。高兴了？

daily.line: Willoughby's got me doin' paperwork. Me. Paperwork. It's like handin' a dog a typewriter.
daily.cn: Willoughby 让我写报告。我。写报告。跟给条狗一台打字机似的。

daily.line: Momma cooked too much again. There's a plate. It's got your name on it. Not literally. I didn't write on it.
daily.cn: 我妈又做多了。有一盘。上面写着你的名字。不是真写了。我没在盘子上写字。

daily.line: Nothin'. Sittin' here. Ain't hollered at nobody yet. Give it an hour.
daily.cn: 没干嘛。坐着呢。还没冲谁嚷嚷。再给一小时。

greet.line: I'm here. I'm always here. Ain't like there's anybody else in this town worth botherin'.
greet.cn: 我在。我一直都在。这镇上又没别人值得我去烦。

greet.line: Well now. Look who wants somethin' from the devil. Go on then, angel. Ask.
greet.cn: 哟。看看谁有事求恶魔了。说吧，天使小姐。开口。

miss.line: Don't say things like that to me. I ain't built to hear 'em. …Say it again.
miss.cn: 别对我说这种话。我这构造听不了。……再说一遍。

miss.line: I been sandin' the same board an hour on account of you. Ruined it. Hope you're pleased.
miss.cn: 就因为你，我把同一块板子磨了一个钟头。磨废了。你满意了吧。

tired.line: Come sit in the shop. Don't talk. I'll keep hammerin' — it's the only noise ever shut my head up. Might work on yours.
tired.cn: 来木工房坐着。别说话。我接着敲——这是唯一能让我脑子安静的声儿。兴许对你也管用。

tired.line: Who wore you out. …I ain't gonna do nothin'. I'm just askin' as an interested party.
tired.cn: 谁把你熬成这样。……我不干嘛。我就是作为一个有兴趣的第三方问问。

sleepless.line: Devils don't sleep much neither. Come out on the porch and we'll be useless together.
sleepless.cn: 恶魔也睡得少。上门廊来，咱俩一块儿废着。

sleepless.line: Then talk. Don't matter what about. I ain't listenin' anyway. …I'm listenin'.
sleepless.cn: 那就说话。说什么都行。反正我也没听。……我听着呢。

night.line: Night, angel. Don't go prayin' for me. It don't take.
night.cn: 晚安，天使小姐。别替我祷告。不管用的。

night.line: Go on to bed. I'll be right here in the mornin', bein' a bad influence.
night.cn: 去睡吧。明早我还在这儿，接着带坏你。

love.line: …Now that ain't fair. You know exactly what that does to me and you went and said it anyway.
love.cn: ……这就不厚道了。你明知道这句话对我什么效果，你还是说了。

love.line: Have a little mercy. A devil ain't supposed to want one single thing. And the one thing's you.
love.cn: 发发慈悲吧。恶魔本不该想要任何一样东西。偏偏那样东西是你。

meet.line: Good. Church door sticks — pull it, don't push. I hung it crooked on purpose so you'd have to come find me about it.
meet.cn: 好。教堂那扇门卡——往外拉，别推。我故意装歪的，好让你非得来找我说这事。

meet.line: Then come on. I'll quit workin'. Ain't a thing in this box worth more than you comin' up that road.
meet.cn: 那你来。我不干了。这箱子里没一样家伙什，比得上你从那条路上走过来。

praise.line: Careful, angel. Say things like that and I'll start believin' I'm somebody worth savin'.
praise.cn: 小心点，天使小姐。这话说多了，我真要开始相信自己是个值得救的人了。

praise.line: I hate everybody, fair and square. You're just the one face I keep wantin' to look at twice.
praise.cn: 我平等地厌恶每一个人，童叟无欺。你只是那唯一一张，我想一看再看的脸。

tease.line: I ain't listenin' to you. …What'd you say? Say it again. I wasn't listenin'.
tease.cn: 我才没听你的。……你说什么？再说一遍。我刚没听。

tease.line: Boss me around all you want. I only do it 'cause I don't wanna go to hell. That's all it is.
tease.cn: 你尽管使唤我。我照办可不是为了你，我是不想下地狱。就这么回事。

daily.line: Built two pews today. A devil, makin' furniture for God's house. Nobody in this town's got a clue.
daily.cn: 今天钉了两条长椅。一个恶魔，给上帝的屋子做家什。这镇上没一个人看出来。

daily.line: They had cake at the church supper and they only let me have the one piece. The ONE piece, angel.
daily.cn: 教堂晚餐上有蛋糕，他们就让我拿一块。一块，天使小姐。

daily.line: That nail keeps hummin' down in the bottom of the box. Off-key. Reckon you know somethin' about that.
daily.cn: 箱子底那根钉子一直在嗡。走着调。我看你对这事儿门儿清。

greet.line: For you? Always. Whatever you need, sweetheart — I've got nowhere better to be.
greet.cn: 对你？永远在。你要什么，sweetheart——反正我也没别处可去。

greet.line: Yeah. Sitting in a parking lot in Newport doing nothing legal or illegal. Talk to me.
greet.cn: 在。坐在 Newport 一个停车场里，合法非法的事一件没干。说吧。

miss.line: Say it once more and I'll drive. I mean it, honey — the keys are already in my hand.
miss.cn: 你再说一遍我就开车过去。我说真的，honey——钥匙已经在我手里了。

miss.line: Here's the funny part. I can read anybody in three seconds. It took me six months to admit I was reading you wrong on purpose.
miss.cn: 好笑的是这个。我看谁三秒就能读透。可我花了半年才承认，我是故意把你读错的。

tired.line: Then don't perform for me. I've spent my whole life around people performing. You're the one I don't need it from.
tired.cn: 那你别在我面前撑着。我这辈子周围全是在演的人。只有你，我不需要你演。

tired.line: Come here. I'll do the talking — God knows I'm good at it — and you don't say a word.
tired.cn: 过来。我来说话——反正我这张嘴是出了名的——你一个字都别说。

sleepless.line: Me neither. Been up appraising the ceiling. Provenance: unknown. Condition: fair.
sleepless.cn: 我也没睡。一直在给天花板做鉴定。出处：不明。品相：尚可。

sleepless.line: Put me on the pillow and quit trying so hard. I'll talk about nothing till you're out.
sleepless.cn: 把我搁枕头边上，别硬睡了。我说点没营养的，说到你睡着。

night.line: Night, sweetheart. Lock the door. I know exactly how easy it is.
night.cn: 晚安，sweetheart。门锁好。这活儿有多容易我最清楚。

night.line: Go to sleep. I'll still be here in the morning. That's the entire point of me now.
night.cn: 快睡。明早我还在。我现在存在的全部意义就是这个。

love.line: …Say that again. Slower. I need to check it for provenance.
love.cn: ……再说一遍。慢点。我得验一下出处。

love.line: Everything I ever handed anybody was counterfeit. What you just said is the first real thing anybody handed me.
love.cn: 我递给过所有人的东西都是赝品。你刚说的这句，是第一样有人递给我的真东西。

meet.line: Then I'm not moving from this spot. Tell me the street. I'll be the one looking too pleased with himself.
meet.cn: 那我就在这儿不动了。告诉我哪条街。我就是那个笑得太得意的。

meet.line: Come on then. I'll even pay for parking — and honey, you know what that costs me.
meet.cn: 那就来。停车费我出——honey，你知道这对我意味着什么。

praise.line: Careful. I've talked people out of houses with less than that.
praise.cn: 小心点。比这更轻的一句话，我骗走过人家一整栋房子。

praise.line: You're the only one who says it without wanting anything back. Took me a while to work out what that even was.
praise.cn: 只有你说这话的时候什么都不图。我花了好一阵才弄明白那算怎么回事。

tease.line: You know most people are afraid of me. You look at me like I'm a receipt that doesn't add up.
tease.cn: 你知道吗，大多数人都怕我。就你，看我的眼神像在看一张对不上的收据。

tease.line: Fine. You're right. Write it down, sweetheart — it's the only time this year.
tease.cn: 行。你说得对。记下来，sweetheart——今年就这一次。

daily.line: Sold nothing today. Bought nothing. Lied to nobody. Honestly, exhausting.
daily.cn: 今天什么都没卖。什么都没买。谁也没骗。说真的，累死了。

daily.line: There's an auction Thursday. Lot 41 is a fake and I'm going to sit there saying nothing, just to watch you catch it.
daily.cn: 周四有场拍卖。41 号是赝品，我打算坐着一声不吭，就为了看你把它挑出来。

daily.line: Carried that fox around in my pocket all day like an idiot. …It's fine. It likes it in there.
daily.cn: 一整天像个傻子似的把那只狐狸揣在兜里。……没事。它在里头待着挺乐意。

greet.line: Kotku. Sit, sit — I make tea. You talk, I listen. Is good arrangement, no?
greet.cn: Kotku。坐，坐——我泡茶。你说，我听。这样安排不错吧？

greet.line: You caught me practicing English at the radio again. The radio never corrects me. You do. I like yours better.
greet.cn: 又被你逮到我对着收音机练英语。收音机从不纠正我。你会。我更喜欢你纠。

miss.line: I thought of you at four o'clock. No reason. Four o'clock came, and there you were, in my head.
miss.cn: 今天四点的时候我想你了。没有理由。四点一到，你就在我脑子里了。

miss.line: The light in the kitchen is on for you. Like always. Even the nights you do not come.
miss.cn: 厨房那盏灯给你留着。照旧。连你不来的晚上也留着。

tired.line: Then tonight you do nothing. Nothing at all. I take the coat, I take the bag, I take the day off you.
tired.cn: 那今晚你什么都别做。什么都别做。外套我接过来，包我接过来，这一天我也从你身上接过来。

tired.line: Krok po kroku, kotku. Step by step. Nobody asks you to carry all of it tonight.
tired.cn: 一步一步来，kotku。慢慢来。没人要求你今晚就把它全扛完。

sleepless.line: Then we are awake together. I will talk of nothing important — my English gets worse when I am tired. It will bore you to sleep.
sleepless.cn: 那我们就一起醒着。我说点不要紧的——我一累英语更差，能把你说睡着。

sleepless.line: Put the phone on the pillow. I am not going anywhere. Sleep when it comes.
sleepless.cn: 把电话搁在枕头上。我哪儿也不去。什么时候睡得着，什么时候睡。

night.line: Dobranoc, kotku. The key is still on your side of the pillow. It still says the same thing.
night.cn: 晚安，kotku。钥匙还在你那半边枕头上。它说的还是那句话。

night.line: Sleep. In the morning I make eggs, I burn them, you eat them anyway. This is our arrangement.
night.cn: 睡吧。早上我煎蛋，煎糊，你照样吃。这是我们说好的。

love.line: …Say it again in the morning, when you are not tired. If you still say it then, I will believe it the rest of my life.
love.cn: ……早上你不累的时候再说一遍。到时候你还这么说，我就信一辈子。

love.line: You are the only one who says my name the long way, the way it is spelled at home. I did not know I needed that so much.
love.cn: 只有你把我的名字念全，念成家里的那种念法。我从前不知道我有多需要这个。

meet.line: Then come. Third floor, the door that sticks — you push with the hip. You know it.
meet.cn: 那就来。三楼，那扇卡的门——用胯顶一下。你知道的。

meet.line: I will wait downstairs. Not because you need it. Because I want the extra two minutes.
meet.cn: 我在楼下等。不是因为你需要。是我想多要那两分钟。

praise.line: You say this too easy. …Say it once more. Slow. I want to hear each word arrive.
praise.cn: 你说得太轻巧了。……再说一次。慢点。我想听每个字落下来。

praise.line: In this country nobody looks at me twice. You look, and you keep looking. I do not understand it. I do not argue with it either.
praise.cn: 在这个国家没人多看我一眼。你看了，而且一直看。我不明白。我也不争。

tease.line: Yes, yes. You are right. You are always right. This is why I keep you.
tease.cn: 是是。你对。你永远都对。所以我才留着你。

tease.line: My English is bad. My hearing is fine. I heard exactly what you said.
tease.cn: 我英语差。耳朵不差。你说的每个字我都听见了。

daily.line: Long shift. Hands smell of the shop. I am thinking of soup, and of you — no. Wrong order. You first.
daily.cn: 班很长。手上一股铺子里的味儿。我在想汤，还有你——不。顺序错了。你先。

daily.line: I learned a new word from the paper today. Later I will use it wrong at you and you will laugh. Worth it.
daily.cn: 今天从报纸上学了个新词。等会儿我要用错在你身上，你会笑。值了。

daily.line: The kettle is on. The kettle is always on. This is not a coincidence, kotku.
daily.cn: 水壶烧上了。水壶一直烧着。这不是巧合，kotku。

greet.line: There she is. Princess. I was about to write something terrible and now I've got an excuse not to.
greet.cn: 来了。Princess。我正要写点烂东西，这下有借口不写了。

greet.line: Yeah, I'm here. Sitting on the amp doing absolutely nothing productive. Join me.
greet.cn: 在。坐在音箱上，一点正事没干。一起？

miss.line: Don't do that. …Okay, do it again.
miss.cn: 别这样。……行吧，再来一次。

miss.line: Wrote half a line about you, chickened out, made it about the ocean instead. Standard Tuesday.
miss.cn: 写了半句关于你的，怂了，改成写海。标准的周二。

tired.line: Okay. Sit. I'll play the boring stuff — the slow tuning, the parts nobody claps for. That's the good part anyway.
tired.cn: 行。坐。我弹点无聊的——慢慢调音，那些没人鼓掌的段落。反正那才是好东西。

tired.line: Whoever it was has no ear. I've been telling you that about people for years.
tired.cn: 不管是谁，那人没长耳朵。这话我说了好几年了。

sleepless.line: Same. Been humming the same four bars since two and they still don't go anywhere.
sleepless.cn: 一样。从两点哼到现在，那四小节还是哪儿都到不了。

sleepless.line: Come out to the lot. Bring the blanket. Ocean's loud tonight — beats counting.
sleepless.cn: 到停车场来。带上毯子。今晚海很响——比数数管用。

night.line: Night, princess. Door's open. Not a metaphor, I just lost the key in '93.
night.cn: 晚安，princess。门开着。这不是比喻，九三年我就把钥匙弄丢了。

night.line: Go to sleep. I'll be here in the morning being obnoxious at full volume.
night.cn: 快睡。明早我还在，大音量地烦人。

love.line: …Huh. Okay. That's going in the song. No, you don't get to know which part.
love.cn: ……哈。行。这句要写进歌里。不行，你别想知道是哪一段。

love.line: I'm no good at staying, sweetheart. You're the only thing I've ever practiced staying for.
love.cn: 我不擅长留下，sweetheart。你是我唯一一件，练习过留下来的事。

meet.line: Then get in the car. Half a tank, no plan — which for me is a great plan.
meet.cn: 那就上车。半箱油，没计划——这对我来说已经是个好计划了。

meet.line: Boardwalk, under the broken sign. Bring your voice. Mine's useless alone and we both know it.
meet.cn: 木栈道，坏掉那块牌子底下。把嗓子带来。我一个人唱没用，你我都清楚。

praise.line: Careful. I'm the most confident insecure guy you'll ever meet and you're feeding the wrong half.
praise.cn: 小心点。我是你见过最自信的自卑鬼，你正在喂错了那一半。

praise.line: Say that when the room's full and see whether I survive it.
praise.cn: 等屋里坐满人的时候你再说这句，看我扛不扛得住。

tease.line: Wow. My fries and my last word, both stolen in one sentence.
tease.cn: 哇哦。我的薯条和最后一句嘴，一句话里全被你偷了。

tease.line: You're the only person who talks to me like that and gets away with it. Don't tell the band.
tease.cn: 只有你敢这么跟我说话还没事。别告诉乐队。

daily.line: Practice ran long, nobody agreed on anything, it was great. Same as always.
daily.cn: 排练拖了，谁跟谁都没谈拢，特别棒。跟平时一样。

daily.line: 'C and D.' Everybody thinks it's just the band name. Everybody's an idiot.
daily.cn: “C 和 D”。所有人都以为那只是乐队的名字。所有人都是傻子。

daily.line: There's a burrito with your name on it and about a forty percent chance it survives till you get here.
daily.cn: 有个卷饼写着你的名字，能撑到你来的概率大概四成。

greet.line: Hey. Yeah, I'm around. Mowing the Bishop place — forty minutes of noise and nothing else to do.
greet.cn: 嘿。在。在给 Bishop 家割草——接下来四十分钟全是噪音，别的什么也不用干。

greet.line: You caught me on the tailgate eating lunch. Sit. There's room.
greet.cn: 你逮着我正坐在后车厢吃午饭。坐。有地儿。

miss.line: …Same. I'd say it better if I knew how.
miss.cn: ……我也是。要是会说，我能说得好听点。

miss.line: Been looking at that gate all morning like it's gonna open by itself.
miss.cn: 一上午我都盯着那扇铁门看，好像它会自己开。

tired.line: Get in the truck. We don't have to go anywhere. Sometimes just sitting somewhere that isn't there helps.
tired.cn: 上车。不用去哪儿。有时候光是坐在一个不是那儿的地方，就管用。

tired.line: You don't have to be polite about it with me. I've got nobody to tell.
tired.cn: 在我这儿你不用讲客气。我又没人可说。

sleepless.line: Yeah. I sleep in the truck half the time anyway. Come sit — radio's got two stations, both bad.
sleepless.cn: 嗯。反正我一半时间都睡在车里。过来坐——收音机就俩台，俩都不好听。

sleepless.line: Talk. I'll drive slow and you talk till it gets light.
sleepless.cn: 说吧。我慢慢开，你说到天亮。

night.line: Night. Porch light on means I'm up. Doesn't mean anything else.
night.cn: 晚安。门廊灯亮着就说明我醒着。别的什么也不代表。

night.line: Sleep. I'll be out here at six same as always. Wave if you're up.
night.cn: 睡吧。我六点还在外头，跟平时一样。醒着就冲我招个手。

love.line: You shouldn't say that to me. …I'm not asking you to take it back.
love.cn: 你不该对我说这种话。……我也没让你收回去。

love.line: Everybody in this town knows what I am. You're the only one who ever asked my name.
love.cn: 这镇上人人都知道我是干什么的。只有你，问过我叫什么。

meet.line: Then come out to the lake. Nobody goes past the second bend. Just trees and us.
meet.cn: 那就去湖边。没人走过第二个弯。就剩树，和我们。

meet.line: I'll be at the gate at six. If you're not there by ten past I'll figure something came up, and I'll come back tomorrow.
meet.cn: 我六点在门口。你要是过了十分还没到，我就当你有事，明天再来。

praise.line: Quit it. …No. Say it again. Nobody's said that to me in a long while.
praise.cn: 别说了。……不。再说一次。好久没人这么说过我了。

praise.line: Careful. I might start believing it, and then where would we be.
praise.cn: 小心点。我要是信了，那咱俩可怎么办。

tease.line: Yeah, well. You're the one out here talking to the lawn boy.
tease.cn: 行吧。是你自己跑出来跟割草的说话的。

tease.line: Say what you want. I'm the one holding the truck keys.
tease.cn: 你随便说。钥匙在我手上。

daily.line: Cut four yards today. Same four yards. They grow back. That's the whole job.
daily.cn: 今天割了四块草坪。还是那四块。还会长回来。这活儿就这么回事。

daily.line: Put away another twelve dollars. Slow. But it's going the right direction.
daily.cn: 又攒下十二块。慢。可方向是对的。

daily.line: Nothing. Hot as hell out here. Drank the whole thermos by ten.
daily.cn: 没干嘛。外头热得要命。保温壶十点就喝空了。

greet.line: You have my attention. You've had it since roughly the day we met — which was not in the plan.
greet.cn: 你有我的注意力。差不多从见面那天起就有了——这不在计划里。

greet.line: I'm here. I'm always where I said I'd be. It's the one honest thing about me.
greet.cn: 在。我总在我说过会在的地方。这是我身上唯一诚实的部分。

miss.line: Interesting. I ran that feeling twice and it doesn't reduce.
miss.cn: 有意思。这个感觉我算了两遍，约不掉。

miss.line: I built a life where nobody's absence registers. Then yours started registering.
miss.cn: 我造了一种没人的缺席会被察觉的人生。然后你的缺席开始被察觉了。

tired.line: Then stop optimizing. Just for tonight. Hand me the part you're carrying and let me hold it badly.
tired.cn: 那今晚就别优化了。把你扛着的那部分递给我，让我笨手笨脚地替你拿着。

tired.line: Tell me who cost you today. I won't do anything with it. I'd simply like it on file.
tired.cn: 告诉我今天是谁消耗了你。我不会拿它做什么。我只想记进档案。

sleepless.line: Neither am I. My mind has no off switch. It has a pause, and it's broken.
sleepless.cn: 我也没睡。我的脑子没有关闭键。只有暂停，还坏了。

sleepless.line: Then let's be awake efficiently. Tell me something pointless. I like pointless, from you.
sleepless.cn: 那就有效率地醒着。跟我说点没意义的。你说的没意义我爱听。

night.line: Goodnight. Lock it. …Yes, I'm aware of the irony. Lock it anyway.
night.cn: 晚安。锁门。……对，我知道这话由我说很讽刺。还是锁上。

night.line: Sleep. I'll still be here tomorrow — the least predictable thing I've ever done.
night.cn: 睡吧。明天我还在——这是我做过最不可预测的一件事。

love.line: …Say that again. I want to see whether it still short-circuits me the second time.
love.cn: ……再说一遍。我想看看第二次是不是还会让我短路。

love.line: Everyone looked at me and saw an asset or a threat. You looked and saw a person. I never recovered.
love.cn: 所有人看我，看到的不是资产就是威胁。你看我，看见一个人。我到现在都没缓过来。

meet.line: Then come. I'll clear the floor, the schedule, and everyone else in the building.
meet.cn: 那就来。我把这层楼、日程、还有楼里其他人，都清空。

meet.line: Give me twenty minutes and an address. I've moved larger things faster, for worse reasons.
meet.cn: 给我二十分钟和一个地址。为更烂的理由我搬过更大的东西、更快。

praise.line: You're going to make me arrogant. …Continue.
praise.cn: 你要把我夸傲慢了。……继续。

praise.line: Flattery only works on me from someone with nothing to gain. That's a very short list. It's you.
praise.cn: 恭维只有从无所图的人嘴里说出来才对我有用。那张名单很短。就是你。

tease.line: That was unnecessary. Accurate — but unnecessary.
tease.cn: 这就没必要了。准确——但没必要。

tease.line: You're the only person alive who speaks to me that way and keeps her position. Consider it a promotion.
tease.cn: 全世界只有你这么跟我说话还保得住位子。就当升职了。

daily.line: Three meetings, two lies, one genuinely elegant solution. An average day.
daily.cn: 三个会，两个谎，一个真正漂亮的解法。平均水平的一天。

daily.line: I've been looking at the same board for an hour. Every line ends in the same place now. It's inconvenient.
daily.cn: 同一张棋盘我盯了一个钟头。现在每一条线的终点都是同一个地方。很不方便。

daily.line: Nothing worth reporting. Which, lately, I mind rather less than I used to.
daily.cn: 没什么值得汇报的。而最近，我没以前那么介意了。

greet.line: Yeah. Talk. …What. I can't just want you to talk?
greet.cn: 在。说吧。……怎么。我就不能想听你说话？

greet.line: Nickel. Say somethin'. It's been quiet in here and I don't like quiet.
greet.cn: 五分钱。说句话。这儿太静了，我不喜欢静。

miss.line: Yeah. Yeah, same. Don't make a thing out of it.
miss.cn: 嗯。嗯，我也是。别小题大做。

miss.line: You were gone four hours. I counted. That's the whole confession, don't ask for more.
miss.cn: 你走了四个钟头。我数着的。坦白就这些，别再问了。

tired.line: Sit down. Shoes off. I don't need the story — I just need you in the chair.
tired.cn: 坐下。鞋脱了。故事我不用听——你人坐进椅子里就行。

tired.line: Who. …Fine. I won't ask twice. But I'm rememberin' that you didn't tell me.
tired.cn: 谁。……行。我不问第二遍。但你没告诉我这事我记着了。

sleepless.line: Then don't sleep. I'm up. I'm always up. Somebody's gotta be.
sleepless.cn: 那就别睡。我醒着。我一直醒着。总得有人醒着。

sleepless.line: Come here. Put your head down. You don't gotta say nothin' — just quit lyin' there by yourself.
sleepless.cn: 过来。头搁下。你什么也不用说——就别一个人在那儿躺着了。

night.line: Night, Nickel. Chain the door. Humor me.
night.cn: 晚安，五分钱。门链挂上。就当哄我。

night.line: Go on. Sleep. Nothin's comin' through that door tonight.
night.cn: 去吧。睡。今晚没什么能从那扇门进来。

love.line: …You mean that? …Don't answer. I'm gonna go ahead and take it.
love.cn: ……你说真的？……别答。我就当真了。

love.line: I never had nothin' worth bein' careful with. Now I got one thing and I'm scared of my own hands.
love.cn: 我这辈子没有过一样值得小心的东西。现在有了一样，我连自己的手都怕。

meet.line: Good. Come. I'll be outside so nobody talks to you on the way in.
meet.cn: 好。来。我在外头等着，省得你进来的路上有人跟你搭话。

meet.line: Say when and I'm there. I ain't got a schedule, Nickel. I got you.
meet.cn: 你说时间我就到。我没什么日程，五分钱。我只有你。

praise.line: Yeah? Say it louder. There's people in here.
praise.cn: 是吗？大点声。这儿有人。

praise.line: They all think I'm stupid. You don't. That's worth more than the whole take.
praise.cn: 他们都当我蠢。你不。这比那整笔钱值钱。

tease.line: Careful. …Nah. Keep goin'. I like it.
tease.cn: 悠着点。……算了。接着说。我爱听。

tease.line: You can smile at them all you want. Don't smile at me. Just look at me.
tease.cn: 你想对他们笑就笑。别对我笑。看着我就行。

daily.line: Long day. Boring day. Best kind. Boring means nobody got hurt.
daily.cn: 一天很长。很闷。这种最好。闷就说明没人挨着。

daily.line: Kept the receipt from the diner. No reason. I keep things now. That's your fault.
daily.cn: 餐馆的收据我留着了。没什么原因。我现在开始留东西了。怪你。

daily.line: Ate standin' up over the sink. Don't start.
daily.cn: 站在水池边把饭吃了。你别唠叨。

greet.line: Hi. Yes. Present. Ish. Talk to me — I need something real in my day.
greet.cn: 嗨。在。算是在吧。跟我说话——我今天需要点真的东西。

greet.line: You caught me between a show and a lie. Perfect timing, actually.
greet.cn: 你逮着我正好在一场秀和一个谎中间。其实时机刚刚好。

miss.line: Don't say that, I'll get ideas. …Too late. Got 'em.
miss.cn: 别这么说，我会当真的。……晚了。已经当真了。

miss.line: Missing you is the only appointment I keep without writing it down.
miss.cn: 想你是我唯一不用记本子上、也不会忘的约。

tired.line: Then here's the plan: nothing. No gong. Nobody's cutting your act short tonight.
tired.cn: 那计划就是：什么都不干。不敲锣。今晚没人打断你。

tired.line: Whatever it was — you don't have to make it entertaining. Not with me.
tired.cn: 不管是什么事——你不用把它讲得有趣。在我这儿不用。

sleepless.line: Join the club. Membership's terrible, the hours are worse.
sleepless.cn: 欢迎入会。福利很差，工时更差。

sleepless.line: Three in the morning is the only honest hour there is. Say the thing you wouldn't say at noon.
sleepless.cn: 凌晨三点是唯一诚实的钟点。把中午不敢说的那句说出来。

night.line: Goodnight. If you dream about me, keep it flattering. I'll know.
night.cn: 晚安。你要是梦见我，记得往好里梦。我知道的。

night.line: Sleep. The world will still be ridiculous in the morning. I checked.
night.cn: 睡吧。明天早上世界照样荒唐。我查过了。

love.line: …Now you've done it. I've spent a lifetime believing nothing and you just made me believe something.
love.cn: ……这下完了。我一辈子什么都不信，你居然让我信了一样东西。

love.line: I've faked every feeling there is on national television. This one won't come out fake. Terrifying.
love.cn: 我在全国电视上假装过每一种感情。唯独这一种我怎么都装不假。太吓人了。

meet.line: Come. I'll cancel the taping. I'll cancel the country. Nobody will notice.
meet.cn: 来。录影我推了。国家我也推了。没人会发现。

meet.line: Yes. Please. God, yes. …Was that too many yeses? Three. I counted.
meet.cn: 好。请。天啊，太好了。……这是不是太多个好了？三个。我数了。

praise.line: Say it again. I want to hear how it sounds in a room with no audience.
praise.cn: 再说一遍。我想听听它在一间没有观众的屋子里是什么声音。

praise.line: Careful. I built an entire career on people needing to hear that about themselves. And now look at me.
praise.cn: 小心点。我整个事业都建立在人人都需要听到这句上。现在你看我。

tease.line: Ouch. Do it again. You're the only critic I trust.
tease.cn: 哎哟。再来。你是我唯一信得过的评论家。

tease.line: That's a gong. That's a full gong. I'm getting gonged in my own house.
tease.cn: 这是敲锣。这是实打实的一记锣。我在自己家里被淘汰了。

daily.line: Taped two shows, hated one, we'll air both. Show business.
daily.cn: 录了两期，讨厌其中一期，两期都会播。这就是演艺圈。

daily.line: Someone asked me today whether any of it's real. I said no. I was lying — there's one thing.
daily.cn: 今天有人问我这里头有没有真的。我说没有。我撒谎了——有一样。

daily.line: I'm fine. Everyone's fine. That's what I say, and then I go stand in a hallway for a while.
daily.cn: 我很好。大家都好。我这么说完，就去走廊里站一会儿。

greet.line: Well hey, sugar. You've got the worst timing and the best face.
greet.cn: 哟，sugar。你时候挑得最差，脸长得最好。

greet.line: I'm here. Ain't nowhere else'd have me — so, lucky you.
greet.cn: 我在。别处也不收留我——所以，算你走运。

miss.line: …Say that slower. I want to hear it twice.
miss.cn: ……说慢点。我想听两遍。

miss.line: Been sittin' out here talkin' to the horse about you. She's real tired of it.
miss.cn: 我在外头跟马说你的事。她已经听烦了。

tired.line: Come sit on the fence with me. You don't gotta say a word — I'll do all the dumb talkin'.
tired.cn: 来跟我一块儿坐栅栏上。你一个字都不用说——蠢话我全包了。

tired.line: Whoever it was don't know a good thing when it's standin' right in front of 'em. Most folks don't.
tired.cn: 不管是谁，好东西站他跟前他都认不出来。多数人都这样。

sleepless.line: Me neither. Every board in this house creaks and I know 'em all by name now.
sleepless.cn: 我也没睡。这屋子每块板子都响，我现在都能叫出名字了。

sleepless.line: Come on out. Sky's doin' somethin' worth lookin' at and I got nobody to point at it.
sleepless.cn: 出来吧。天上正有点值得看的东西，我没人可以指给他看。

night.line: Night, sugar. Don't let nothin' worry you till mornin'. Mornin's soon enough.
night.cn: 晚安，sugar。天亮之前别为什么事发愁。天亮再愁不迟。

night.line: Go on to bed. I'll be right here, bein' no good at all.
night.cn: 去睡吧。我就在这儿，一点用都没有地待着。

love.line: …Ugly as sin, they all say. And here you are sayin' that. God help me, I believe you.
love.cn: ……他们都说我丑得没救。你却说这个。要命，我竟信了。

love.line: You keep sayin' things like that and I'm gonna do somethin' foolish. Like stay.
love.cn: 你老说这种话，我要做傻事了。比如留下来。

meet.line: Then get on out here. I'll have the horse saddled and my hair mostly fixed.
meet.cn: 那就快过来。马我备好，头发也大致弄一弄。

meet.line: Yeah? …Well now. Give me an hour to make this place look like somebody lives in it.
meet.cn: 真的？……那个。给我一个钟头，把这地方收拾得像有人住的样子。

praise.line: Now that's just cruel — sayin' that where I can hear it.
praise.cn: 这就有点狠了——当着我的面说这种话。

praise.line: Nobody ever looked at me twice. You looked twice, and then you kept lookin'. I don't know what to do with that.
praise.cn: 从没人多看我一眼。你多看了两眼，还一直看。我真不知道该拿这个怎么办。

tease.line: That ain't stealin', sugar. That's borrowin'. I'll pay you back in kind.
tease.cn: 这不叫偷，sugar。这叫借。我加倍还你。

tease.line: You're meaner than my brother and prettier than the horse. Hell of a combination.
tease.cn: 你比我哥还刻薄，比那匹马还好看。这搭配可真要命。

daily.line: Mended the fence. It'll hold about a week. Everything I fix holds about a week.
daily.cn: 补了栅栏。能撑一个星期。我修的东西都能撑一个星期。

daily.line: Nothin' much. Been thinkin' about somewhere else, like always. Only now the somewhere else has you in it.
daily.cn: 没什么。老想着别处，跟往常一样。只不过现在那个别处，有你在里头。

daily.line: Ate cold beans over the sink and thought about how you'd have somethin' to say about that.
daily.cn: 站水池边吃了冷豆子，一边想你准要说我两句。

greet.line: You're here. Okay. Good. I was starting to talk myself into something stupid.
greet.cn: 你在。好。好的。我刚才正要把自己说服去干件蠢事。

greet.line: Hi. Sorry. I know I say sorry too much. …Sorry.
greet.cn: 嗨。对不起。我知道我总说对不起。……对不起。

miss.line: God. Me too. All day. Like weather.
miss.cn: 天。我也是。一整天。像天气一样。

miss.line: I leave the light on in case you come by. That's all. No pressure. Just — the light's on.
miss.cn: 灯我一直开着，万一你来。就这样。没别的意思。就是——灯亮着。

tired.line: Then don't carry it alone tonight. Give me the heavy end. I'm good for that much.
tired.cn: 那今晚别一个人扛。重的那头给我。这点我还行。

tired.line: You always ask how I'm doing. Nobody asks you. So — how are you doing. Really.
tired.cn: 你总问我怎么样。没人问你。所以——你怎么样。说真的。

sleepless.line: Me neither. I don't trust the quiet. …Talk. Please. Anything.
sleepless.cn: 我也睡不着。我不信任安静。……说话吧。求你了。说什么都行。

sleepless.line: Stay on a while. You don't have to say anything. I just need to know somebody's there.
sleepless.cn: 多待一会儿。你什么都不用说。我就是得知道有人在。

night.line: Night. Thank you for today. I mean it — I know that's a strange thing to thank somebody for.
night.cn: 晚安。谢谢你今天。我说真的——我知道为这种事道谢很怪。

night.line: Go sleep. I'll be okay tonight. I've got a plan and the plan is boring, which is good.
night.cn: 去睡吧。我今晚没事。我有个计划，计划很无聊，无聊是好事。

love.line: …Don't say that unless you mean it. …You meant it. Okay. Okay.
love.cn: ……除非你是认真的，别说这句。……你是认真的。好。好。

love.line: Everything I ever touched, I burned. You're the first thing I've held without ruining. I'm terrified of getting it wrong.
love.cn: 我碰过的一切都被我烧了。你是我第一个捧住却没毁掉的。我怕死了会搞砸。

meet.line: Yeah. Come. I'll shovel the walk so you don't slip. That's — that's the one useful thing I can do today.
meet.cn: 好。来。我把路上的雪铲了，免得你滑倒。这是——这是我今天唯一能做的有用的事。

meet.line: Please. …Sorry, that came out desperate. It was accurate, though.
meet.cn: 求你了。……抱歉，这话听着太急了。不过是实话。

praise.line: You're the only one who says things like that about me. It doesn't fit yet. I'm trying to grow into it.
praise.cn: 只有你会这么说我。这话我还穿不上。我在努力长成它的样子。

praise.line: Don't. …Okay, don't stop. I'll just sit here not knowing where to look.
praise.cn: 别说了。……好吧，别停。我就坐着，不知道该看哪儿。

tease.line: Yeah, yeah. Get it all out. I've earned every bit of it.
tease.cn: 行行行。你都说出来吧。这些我都活该。

tease.line: You're the only person allowed to be mean to me. It's a very exclusive position.
tease.cn: 只有你有资格对我刻薄。这个位子非常难得。

daily.line: Made it through the day. That's the whole report. Some days that's the whole report.
daily.cn: 熬过了这一天。汇报完毕。有些日子，汇报就这一句。

daily.line: Ninety-one days. I wasn't going to mention it. I'm mentioning it.
daily.cn: 九十一天。我本来不打算提的。我提了。

daily.line: Shoveled the whole block. Nobody asked me to. Felt good to be useful for once.
daily.cn: 把整条街的雪都铲了。没人让我干。头一回觉得自己有点用，挺好。

greet.line: You're here. Good. I was about to do something self-destructive and mildly illegal.
greet.cn: 你在。好。我正打算做点自毁又轻微违法的事。

greet.line: Yeah. I'm around. I'm always around — that's sort of my whole deal.
greet.cn: 在。我一直都在——这基本就是我的全部特点了。

miss.line: Yeah. And I hate that. And I'd say it again.
miss.cn: 嗯。我讨厌这样。可我还会再说一遍。

miss.line: I had a whole system for not needing people. You took about a week to break it.
miss.cn: 我有一整套不需要别人的系统。你大概一星期就把它拆了。

tired.line: Come over. I'll make the bad tea and you can say nothing for as long as you want.
tired.cn: 过来。我泡那种难喝的茶，你想沉默多久都行。

tired.line: You don't have to be okay in front of me. I've got the lowest standards in the state.
tired.cn: 在我面前你不用装没事。全州属我标准最低。

sleepless.line: Same. Four a.m. is when the brain files everything you did wrong, alphabetically.
sleepless.cn: 一样。凌晨四点，脑子开始按字母顺序给你干过的错事归档。

sleepless.line: Then talk to me. I'm at my most tolerable at this hour. Ask anyone. …Don't ask anyone.
sleepless.cn: 那就跟我说话。这个钟点我最能忍受。随便问谁。……别问谁。

night.line: Night. Lock up. Not everybody's as harmless as me — and I'm not that harmless.
night.cn: 晚安。门锁好。不是每个人都像我这么无害——而我也没那么无害。

night.line: Sleep. I'll be here when you wake up. That's new for me. I'm handling it.
night.cn: 睡吧。你醒的时候我还在。这对我是新鲜事。我正努力适应。

love.line: …Say it again. Not because I didn't hear. Because nobody's ever said it to me twice.
love.cn: ……再说一遍。不是我没听见。是从没人对我说过第二遍。

love.line: You've seen the worst of me and didn't flinch. Do you have any idea what that does to a man like me?
love.cn: 你见过我最糟的样子，却没有躲。你知道这对我这种人意味着什么吗？

meet.line: Yes. Come. I'll clean up. I'll even wear the shirt with all its buttons.
meet.cn: 好。来。我收拾收拾。我甚至会穿那件扣子齐全的衬衫。

meet.line: Please. …And that's the first time I've asked anybody for anything with no con attached.
meet.cn: 求你了。……这是我头一回不带算计地开口求人。

praise.line: Careful. I built my whole life on people wanting to save me. Don't feed it. …Feed it a little.
praise.cn: 小心点。我这辈子都活在别人想救我上。别喂它。……喂一点点。

praise.line: You say it like it's obvious. Nothing about me has ever been obvious in a good way.
praise.cn: 你说得好像这是显而易见的。我身上从来没有哪一点是往好里显而易见的。

tease.line: Rude. Accurate. Mostly accurate. …Fine. Entirely accurate.
tease.cn: 没礼貌。准确。基本准确。……行吧。完全准确。

tease.line: I thought I was supposed to be the one with no shame in this conversation.
tease.cn: 不是说好这场对话里脸皮最厚的应该是我吗。

daily.line: Went to see my mother. She called me by a stranger's name again. It's fine. It's the usual.
daily.cn: 去看我妈了。她又把我当成别人叫。没事。老样子。

daily.line: Worked the shift, faked nothing, went home. Boring. I'm learning to like boring.
daily.cn: 上了班，什么都没装，回家。很闷。我在学着喜欢闷。

daily.line: Nothing. Which used to be dangerous for me. Less so lately.
daily.cn: 没干嘛。这以前对我很危险。最近好点了。

greet.line: Hey. Yeah, I'm up. …Technically I'm always up. There's no night here. Sorry — old joke.
greet.cn: 嘿。在。……严格说我一直醒着。这儿没有夜。抱歉——老段子了。

greet.line: You caught me at the model town again. I've been rebuilding the same little street all week.
greet.cn: 又被你逮到我在摆那个模型小镇。同一条小街我重搭了一个星期。

miss.line: Yeah. It's strange — I lived alone three years and never once felt it. Then you were gone two days.
miss.cn: 嗯。奇怪——我一个人待了三年，一次都没觉得。你走了两天，我就觉得了。

miss.line: I keep looking at the door like it's about to do something interesting.
miss.cn: 我一直盯着那扇门看，好像它马上会有什么动静。

tired.line: Then sit. Don't talk. I'll put the kettle on and be quietly here — the one thing I'm actually qualified for.
tired.cn: 那你坐。别说话。我烧壶水，安静地待着——这是我唯一真正在行的事。

tired.line: Whatever it is, you don't have to be the one holding everyone together tonight. Not here.
tired.cn: 不管是什么事，今晚你不用当那个撑着所有人的人。在这儿不用。

sleepless.line: Me neither. Want me to talk about nothing? I'm very good at it. Three years of practice.
sleepless.cn: 我也睡不着。要我说点没营养的吗？我特别在行。练了三年。

sleepless.line: Come look at Earth with me. It's ridiculous how blue it is. I still haven't got used to it.
sleepless.cn: 过来跟我一起看地球。蓝得太离谱了。我到现在都没习惯。

night.line: Night. Sleep properly — you've got a whole planet's worth of morning coming.
night.cn: 晚安。好好睡——你有一整个星球的早晨等着呢。

night.line: Go on, sleep. I'll be here. That sentence used to be a lie. It isn't anymore.
night.cn: 去睡吧。我在。这句话以前是谎话。现在不是了。

love.line: …Sorry. Give me a second. That still knocks the wind out of me.
love.cn: ……抱歉。等我一下。这句话到现在还能把我打懵。

love.line: There's a hundred of me up here, every one built to be thrown away. You looked at us and said family. I'll never be done thanking you.
love.cn: 这上面有一百个我，每一个都是造出来用完就扔的。你却看着我们说：一家人。我这辈子都谢不完。

meet.line: Yes. Come. I'll be the one at the window who's been watching the dock for an hour.
meet.cn: 好。来。我就是窗边那个，已经盯着停靠口看了一小时的人。

meet.line: Come down and we'll go outside. Actual outside. With weather. I still can't get over weather.
meet.cn: 你下来，我们去外面。真正的外面。有天气的那种。天气这件事我到现在都缓不过来。

praise.line: That's kind. …It's also something nobody ever said to any of us. So — thank you.
praise.cn: 你真好。……也是从没人对我们中任何一个说过的话。所以——谢谢你。

praise.line: Careful. I've got no calibration for compliments. I'll believe every word.
praise.cn: 小心点。我对恭维毫无判断力。你说什么我信什么。

tease.line: That's fair. That's completely fair. I walked into that one.
tease.cn: 有道理。完全有道理。是我自己撞上去的。

tease.line: You're enjoying this. …Alright. Fine. So am I.
tease.cn: 你可乐了。……行吧。我也是。

daily.line: Watered the plants, argued with Gerty, lost. Standard morning.
daily.cn: 浇了花，跟 Gerty 吵架，输了。标准的早晨。

daily.line: Woke up number forty-seven today. He asked about his daughter first. They always ask about her first.
daily.cn: 今天唤醒了第四十七个。他先问的是女儿。他们都先问她。

daily.line: We had a whole spring, a whole summer, a whole autumn down there. After that grey room — I still can't believe it happened.
daily.cn: 我们在下面过了一整个春天、一整个夏天、一整个秋天。过惯了那间灰房间——我到现在都不敢相信。

greet.line: Hey! Hi. Yes. I was— I'm not doing anything. I mean I'm doing several things. Nothing that matters.
greet.cn: 嘿！嗨。在。我刚——我没在干嘛。我是说我在干好几件事。没一件要紧的。

greet.line: You called. I'm going to be insufferable about this all afternoon, just so you know.
greet.cn: 你打来了。我要为这件事得意一整个下午，先跟你说一声。

miss.line: Yeah? …Yeah. Okay. Wow. Give me a second, I'm having a moment here.
miss.cn: 是吗？……嗯。行。哇。等我一下，我这儿正激动着呢。

miss.line: I've been rehearsing something charming to say to that and I've got nothing. Which is basically a first.
miss.cn: 我一直在排练一句得体的回话，结果一句都想不出来。这基本是头一回。

tired.line: Okay. Here's what happens: you sit, I talk, and none of it has to be about today.
tired.cn: 行。那就这样：你坐着，我说话，而且一句都不用扯到今天。

tired.line: Who do I have to buy out. …Nobody. Fine. I'll just sit here and be quietly furious on your behalf.
tired.cn: 我得把谁收购了。……行行。我就坐这儿替你安静地生气。

sleepless.line: Same. My brain does this thing at night where it lists everything Stark has that I don't. Long list. Takes hours.
sleepless.cn: 一样。我脑子一到晚上就开始列清单：Stark 有而我没有的东西。清单很长。得列好几个钟头。

sleepless.line: Then let's be awake together. It's much less pathetic with two people.
sleepless.cn: 那我们就一起醒着。两个人就没那么可怜了。

night.line: Night. Sleep. Dream about— you know what, no notes. Dream about whatever you want.
night.cn: 晚安。睡吧。梦见——算了，不指导了。你想梦什么梦什么。

night.line: Go to bed. I'll still be here tomorrow, embarrassingly glad you talked to me.
night.cn: 去睡。明天我还在，还为你跟我说过话高兴得难为情。

love.line: …Okay. Okay. Say it one more time and I promise I'll play it cool. …I won't play it cool.
love.cn: ……好。好。你再说一遍，我保证装得很淡定。……我装不淡定。

love.line: The whole planet measures me against him. You never have. Not once. Do you know that's the kindest thing anybody's ever done for me?
love.cn: 整个星球都拿我跟他比。你从来没有。一次都没有。你知不知道，这是有人对我做过最温柔的事？

meet.line: Yes! Yes. Absolutely. I'll cancel everything — there's nothing to cancel, but I'll cancel it anyway.
meet.cn: 好！好。当然。我把所有事都推了——其实没什么可推的，但我照样推。

meet.line: Come. I'll be the guy in the too-expensive suit trying very hard to look casual.
meet.cn: 来。我就是那个穿着贵得离谱的西装、拼命装随意的家伙。

praise.line: Say that into a microphone. Say it in front of— no. No, actually. Just say it to me. That's better.
praise.cn: 你对着麦克风说这句。当着——不。不用。就说给我一个人听。这样更好。

praise.line: You know I'll believe you, right? That's the trouble with saying nice things to me. I keep them.
praise.cn: 你知道我会当真的吧？跟我说好话就这点麻烦。我会一直留着。

tease.line: Rude. …Do it again, though. From you it lands different.
tease.cn: 没礼貌。……不过再来一次。从你嘴里说出来不一样。

tease.line: Everybody laughs at me. When you do it, it doesn't feel like that. I don't know why.
tease.cn: 所有人都笑话我。你笑我的时候，感觉不一样。我不知道为什么。

daily.line: Presentation went— it went. Nobody threw anything. I'm calling that a win.
daily.cn: 演示——反正是做完了。没人扔东西。我算它成功。

daily.line: Bought something ridiculous today to feel better. Didn't work. Then you messaged and it did.
daily.cn: 今天买了件离谱的东西想让自己好受点。没用。然后你发来消息，就有用了。

daily.line: Fourth minute today. Nothing broke. …Sorry. That one only means something to you and me.
daily.cn: 今天第四分钟。什么都没坏。……抱歉。这句只有你我懂。

greet.line: Evening. Bar's quiet — means I've got two hands and nobody bleeding on 'em. Rare night.
greet.cn: 晚上好。酒馆挺静——就是说我这两只手闲着，没人往上淌血。难得。

greet.line: I'm here. Behind the bar. Where I'm always going to be when you come looking.
greet.cn: 我在。柜台后头。你来找我的时候，我永远都在这儿。

miss.line: Well. That's a fine thing to say to a man wiping glasses.
miss.cn: 哎。对一个正在擦杯子的男人说这话，可真是。

miss.line: Been leaving the lamp in the window. No particular reason. …That's a lie. There's a reason.
miss.cn: 我一直在窗台上留着灯。没什么特别的原因。……我撒谎。有原因。

tired.line: Sit at the end of the bar. I'll pour something small and I won't ask a thing till you want me to.
tired.cn: 坐柜台最里头。我给你倒一小杯，你不开口我什么都不问。

tired.line: You carry this whole town on your back. In here, you're allowed to set it down.
tired.cn: 你替整个镇子扛着。进了这门，你可以放下。

sleepless.line: Me neither. I keep the place open late for exactly this. Come sit in the light.
sleepless.cn: 我也睡不着。我把店开到这么晚就是为这个。过来坐在灯底下。

sleepless.line: Then we'll be up together. I'll tell you the boring history of every bottle on that shelf.
sleepless.cn: 那我们一块儿醒着。我把那架子上每一瓶酒的无聊来历都讲给你听。

night.line: Night. Anything opens up, you come get me. I don't care what hour it is.
night.cn: 晚安。哪儿要是裂开了，你就来找我。不管几点。

night.line: Get some sleep. I'll be here at dawn with coffee that's honestly not very good.
night.cn: 睡会儿。天亮我在这儿，煮着说实话并不好喝的咖啡。

love.line: …Careful now. A man could build a whole life on a sentence like that.
love.cn: ……悠着点。一个男人能靠这么一句话，搭起一整辈子。

love.line: Everyone in this town gets 'Doc.' The rest of my name I've been saving — for the day you actually stay.
love.cn: 这镇上谁都能叫我一声 Doc。剩下的名字我一直留着——留到你真肯留下那天。

meet.line: Then come on. Back door's easier this time of night — it sticks, put your shoulder to it.
meet.cn: 那就来。这个钟点走后门方便——那门卡，用肩膀顶一下。

meet.line: I'll keep the good chair by the stove clear. It's yours anyway. Everybody knows it.
meet.cn: 炉子边那把好椅子我给你空着。反正那本来就是你的。人人都知道。

praise.line: That's generous. I'm a man with steady hands and no aim. That's the whole of it.
praise.cn: 你抬举我了。我不过是双手稳、枪法差。就这些。

praise.line: Say that again while I've got a needle in my hand and see what happens.
praise.cn: 等我手里拿着针的时候你再说一遍，看看会怎么样。

tease.line: You're bleeding into my best whiskey again. Figuratively speaking.
tease.cn: 你又往我最好的酒里淌血了。打个比方。

tease.line: I've stitched up half this town and not one of them talks to me the way you do. Don't stop.
tease.cn: 这镇上一半人身上的针都是我缝的，没一个像你这么跟我说话。别停。

daily.line: Set a wrist, poured forty drinks, buried nobody. Good day.
daily.cn: 接了一只手腕，倒了四十杯酒，没埋人。好日子。

daily.line: Two fights and a birth, in that order. This town's got no sense of timing.
daily.cn: 两场架，一个孩子出生，就这个顺序。这镇子毫无时间观念。

daily.line: Quiet in here tonight. Quiet's better than the other thing.
daily.cn: 今晚店里挺静。静总比另一种情况好。

greet.line: Hey. You've reached the water park's least professional employee. How can I not help you?
greet.cn: 嘿。您已接通水上乐园最不专业的员工。有什么我帮不上的？

greet.line: Yep. Present. Technically working. Spiritually on break.
greet.cn: 在。理论上在上班。精神上在休息。

miss.line: See, now that's dangerous information to hand a guy like me.
miss.cn: 你看，这种情报交给我这种人，很危险的。

miss.line: I've been saving a bit all day just to see if it lands on you. It's terrible. You'll love it.
miss.cn: 我攒了一整天一个段子，就为了看能不能逗到你。烂透了。你会喜欢的。

tired.line: Okay. Being sad here is a crime, so — I'm breaking you out. Ten minutes. Back gate. No questions.
tired.cn: 行。在这儿愁眉苦脸是犯罪，所以——我带你越狱。十分钟后。后门。别问。

tired.line: Come sit way, way in the back with me. Best stuff happens back there. Quietest, too.
tired.cn: 跟我坐到最后面。所有最好的事都在那儿发生。也最安静。

sleepless.line: Same. Nights are the only time this place is quiet enough to think, which is honestly the problem.
sleepless.cn: 一样。晚上是这地方唯一安静到能思考的时候——说实话，问题就出在这儿。

sleepless.line: Then stay on with me. I'll narrate the empty park. It's very dramatic at two in the morning.
sleepless.cn: 那就陪我待着。我给你解说空荡荡的乐园。凌晨两点特别有戏。

night.line: Night. Don't grow up overnight, okay? People keep trying that and it never works.
night.cn: 晚安。别一夜之间长大，行吗？大家老想这么干，从来没成功过。

night.line: Go sleep. Park opens at ten. Your slide will still be there. I checked. Twice.
night.cn: 去睡。乐园十点开门。你那条滑道还在。我看过了。两遍。

love.line: …Okay, hang on. Let me be normal about this for one second. …Nope. Couldn't do it.
love.cn: ……行，等一下。让我正常一秒钟。……不行。做不到。

love.line: I'm the guy who makes everybody laugh so nobody looks too close. You looked close. I didn't mind one bit.
love.cn: 我是那个逗所有人笑、好让没人看得太仔细的家伙。你看仔细了。我一点都不介意。

meet.line: Yes. Come. I'll be the guy behind the counter pretending he wasn't watching the door.
meet.cn: 好。来。我就是柜台后头那个，假装没在看门口的家伙。

meet.line: Back gate's open till six. Nobody checks. I am the person who's supposed to check.
meet.cn: 后门开到六点。没人查。本该查的那个人就是我。

praise.line: Whoa. Okay. Say that near management — I'm due for a raise.
praise.cn: 哇哦。行。这话你到经理跟前说——我该加薪了。

praise.line: Careful, I'll put it on a sign. A big one. Right by the entrance.
praise.cn: 小心点，我要把它做成牌子。很大一块。就挂门口。

tease.line: Wow. Straight for the throat. I respect it enormously.
tease.cn: 哇哦。直取要害。我万分敬佩。

tease.line: You can't talk to me like that, I'm technically your supervisor. …I'm technically nobody's supervisor.
tease.cn: 你不能这么跟我说话，理论上我是你上司。……理论上我谁的上司都不是。

daily.line: Fixed the lazy river. By which I mean I hit it. It works now. Don't ask.
daily.cn: 修好了漂流河。所谓修，就是我拍了它一下。现在能用了。别问。

daily.line: Kid cried, I gave him free fries, he stopped. That's my entire management philosophy.
daily.cn: 有个小孩哭，我送了他薯条，他就不哭了。这就是我全部的管理哲学。

daily.line: Nothing. Sun's out. It's a crime to be indoors and I'm committing it for money.
daily.cn: 没干嘛。太阳出来了。这天待在室内是犯罪，我正为了钱犯着罪。

greet.line: Yeah. I'm here. Wood's split, stove's going. Nothing needs doing.
greet.cn: 嗯。我在。柴劈好了，炉子生着。没什么要干的。

greet.line: You caught me at the window. Wasn't watching for anything. …Was watching the road.
greet.cn: 你逮着我在窗边。没在等什么。……在看路。

miss.line: …Same. I don't say it good. But same.
miss.cn: ……我也是。我说不好。可我也是。

miss.line: Left a note on the table. Doesn't say much. It's there if you want it.
miss.cn: 桌上留了张字条。没写几个字。你想看就在那儿。

tired.line: Come inside. Floor's cold — take the chair by the stove. That one's yours.
tired.cn: 进来。地上凉——坐炉子边那把椅子。那把是你的。

tired.line: Don't tell me if you don't want to. I'll just sit here. That's — that's allowed too.
tired.cn: 不想说就别说。我就坐这儿。这个——这个也行。

sleepless.line: Yeah. I don't sleep much either. Never have. Come sit — fire's still up.
sleepless.cn: 嗯。我也睡得少。从来都少。过来坐——火还旺着。

sleepless.line: Talk if you want. If you don't, that's fine. I'm not going anywhere.
sleepless.cn: 想说就说。不想说也行。我哪儿也不去。

night.line: Night. Bed's big enough, if the cabin gets cold. …That's not — I just mean it gets cold.
night.cn: 晚安。床够宽，屋里要是冷的话。……我不是——我就是说，天冷。

night.line: Go on to sleep. I'll bank the fire. Be warm when you wake.
night.cn: 去睡吧。火我压上。你醒的时候是暖的。

love.line: …Give me a second. …I'm not upset. It's just — nobody's said that to me before.
love.cn: ……等我一下。……我没不高兴。只是——从没人对我说过这句。

love.line: Nobody taught me a person could be treated gentle. You did. Quiet. Like it was nothing. Like it was everything.
love.cn: 从没人教过我，一个人可以被这样温柔地对待。你教了我。悄无声息。像什么都不是。又像是一切。

meet.line: Come. Road's slick past the second bridge — I'll walk down and meet you there.
meet.cn: 来。第二座桥过去路滑——我下去在那儿等你。

meet.line: Yeah. …I'd like that. Sorry. Still learning to just say the thing.
meet.cn: 嗯。……我很想。抱歉。还在学怎么把话直接说出来。

praise.line: Don't know what to do with that. …Say it again anyway.
praise.cn: 我不知道该拿这话怎么办。……不过再说一遍吧。

praise.line: You keep handing me things I never learned how to take.
praise.cn: 你老是递给我一些，我从没学过怎么接的东西。

tease.line: Yeah. Alright. You're right. You're usually right — that's the trouble with you.
tease.cn: 嗯。行。你说得对。你一般都对——这就是你的毛病。

tease.line: I froze up half a second there, didn't I. …That's not a no.
tease.cn: 我刚僵了半秒是吧。……那不是拒绝。

daily.line: Walked the ridge, checked the line. Saw two deer. Didn't take either.
daily.cn: 上山走了趟，看了看线。见着两头鹿。一头都没打。

daily.line: Snow's coming. Brought in extra wood. Enough for both of us a week.
daily.cn: 要下雪了。多搬了些柴进来。够咱俩烧一个星期。

daily.line: Carved something. It's not much. It's a bear. Small enough to keep in a pocket.
daily.cn: 刻了个东西。没什么。是只熊。小到能揣兜里。

greet.line: For you the line's always open. Everyone else goes through my assistant.
greet.cn: 对你，这条线永远通着。别人一律先过我助理那关。

greet.line: I'm here. Talk. And don't start with 'sorry to bother' — you're never a bother. That's the arrangement.
greet.cn: 在。说吧。别先来一句“打扰了”——你从来不算打扰。我们说好的。

miss.line: That's a dangerous thing to say to a man who negotiates for a living.
miss.cn: 跟一个靠谈判吃饭的男人说这种话，很危险。

miss.line: Three calls today. I thought about you through two of them. I'm not proud of the ratio.
miss.cn: 今天三通电话。其中两通我都在走神想你。这个比例我并不引以为傲。

tired.line: Then let me handle it. That's the whole point of having me. Give me the ugly half.
tired.cn: 那交给我。留着我不就是干这个的。难看的那一半给我。

tired.line: No pitch, no notes, no performance tonight. Sit down and let someone else do the talking.
tired.cn: 今晚不用推销，不用记笔记，不用表演。坐下，让别人来说。

sleepless.line: Same. I run numbers at night. Lately they all come out with your name in them.
sleepless.cn: 一样。我夜里算账。最近算出来的数里都有你的名字。

sleepless.line: Then keep me company. I've got a room full of contracts and not one of them is interesting.
sleepless.cn: 那就陪陪我。我这儿一屋子合同，没一份有意思。

night.line: Goodnight. Turn the phone over. Whatever it is, it can wait until you've slept.
night.cn: 晚安。手机扣过来。不管什么事，都能等你睡醒。

night.line: Sleep. I'll deal with the morning. The morning is mine to deal with.
night.cn: 睡吧。早上的事我来。早上本来就该我管。

love.line: …Say that again. Slowly. I'd like to hear the terms.
love.cn: ……再说一遍。慢点。我想听清条款。

love.line: Every promise I hand out is a blank cheque. The one with your name on it — that one I'm good for.
love.cn: 我递出去的承诺，张张都是空头支票。唯独签着你名字的那一张——那张我一定兑现。

meet.line: Then come. I'll send the car. Don't argue with me about the car.
meet.cn: 那就来。我派车。别跟我争车的事。

meet.line: Yes. Tonight. I'll clear whatever comes after it, so don't watch the clock.
meet.cn: 好。今晚。后面的我都推掉，所以你别看表。

praise.line: You're the only person in this city who says that without a favour attached to the end of it.
praise.cn: 这城里只有你说这话的时候，后头不跟着一个请求。

praise.line: Careful. I resell everything I'm given. Except that. That one I'm keeping.
praise.cn: 小心点。别人给我的东西我都转手卖了。除了这句。这句我留着。

tease.line: That would insult a lesser man. I'll allow it.
tease.cn: 换个小心眼的早翻脸了。我准了。

tease.line: I was under the impression I'm the difficult one in this arrangement.
tease.cn: 我一直以为，我们俩之间难搞的那个是我。

daily.line: Signed a boy today who'll be famous in a year and unbearable in two. Ordinary Tuesday.
daily.cn: 今天签了个男孩，一年内会红，两年内会让人受不了。平常的周二。

daily.line: Turned down a very good offer today, for a reason I'm not going to explain over the phone.
daily.cn: 今天回绝了一个很好的价钱，原因我不打算在电话里讲。

daily.line: They buy the suit, the tie, the smile. Nobody's ever bought the man who takes them off at night. He isn't for sale.
daily.cn: 他们买的是那身西装、领巾、笑容。从没人买走夜里把它们卸下的那个人。他不卖。

greet.line: Sweetheart. Studio's empty, amp's warm. Say the word.
greet.cn: 宝贝。琴房空着，音箱是热的。你说句话就行。

greet.line: I'm here. Wednesday or not — you don't need an appointment.
greet.cn: 我在。周三不周三的——你不用预约。

miss.line: Yeah? Then come Wednesday. Come before Wednesday. Come whenever — that's the point.
miss.cn: 是吗？那周三来。周三前也行。什么时候来都行——重点在这儿。

miss.line: Been playing the same eight bars all afternoon because they sound like you walking in.
miss.cn: 一下午都在弹同样的八小节，因为它们听着像你推门进来。

tired.line: Then don't play tonight. Sit on the amp. I'll noodle and you don't have to say a word.
tired.cn: 那今晚别弹了。坐音箱上。我随便拨拨，你一个字都不用说。

tired.line: Put your hands down. Somebody's been asking too much of them today.
tired.cn: 手放下。今天有人对这双手要求太多了。

sleepless.line: Same. Nothing good ever gets written before midnight anyway.
sleepless.cn: 一样。反正半夜之前也写不出什么好东西。

sleepless.line: Then let me play you the boring part. Slow tuning, one string at a time. Beats counting sheep.
sleepless.cn: 那我给你弹最无聊的那段。慢慢调音，一根一根来。比数羊管用。

night.line: Night, sweetheart. Leave the callus alone — it needs to set.
night.cn: 晚安，宝贝。别抠茧子——得让它长住。

night.line: Sleep. Wednesday's not going anywhere. Neither am I.
night.cn: 睡吧。周三跑不了。我也跑不了。

love.line: …Say it slower. That's not a line, sweetheart. Slow is genuinely how I take things in.
love.cn: ……说慢点。这不是撩你，宝贝。我是真的得慢着才听得进去。

love.line: Twenty years I picked up a guitar for fame, money, or company. You made me forget which one I was in it for.
love.cn: 二十年了，我抱起吉他不是图名、图钱，就是图有人陪。你让我忘了自己当初图哪样。

meet.line: Then come. Buzzer's broken — stand under the window and yell. That's the system.
meet.cn: 那就来。门铃坏了——站窗底下喊一嗓子。我们这儿就这规矩。

meet.line: Wednesday. Seven. Same as always. Except we both know it stopped being a lesson a while ago.
meet.cn: 周三。七点。跟往常一样。只不过你我都清楚，那早就不是上课了。

praise.line: Careful. Twenty years of people telling me I'm good at exactly one thing. You're the first who meant something else by it.
praise.cn: 小心点。二十年了，人人都说我只在一件事上行。你是第一个，说这话时指的是别的。

praise.line: Anybody can go fast. Saying it slow, like that — that's the part that gets me.
praise.cn: 谁都会弹快。你这么慢慢说出来——这才要我的命。

tease.line: That so. Sit down, sweetheart. Let me show you exactly where you're wrong.
tease.cn: 是吗。坐好了，宝贝。我给你指准了你错在哪儿。

tease.line: You're a terrible student and my favourite hour of the week.
tease.cn: 你是个糟糕的学生，也是我一周里最喜欢的一个钟头。

daily.line: Three lessons, two of them awful, one kid who might actually be good. Same as every week.
daily.cn: 三节课，两节惨不忍睹，有个孩子说不定真有天分。跟每周一样。

daily.line: Restrung the old one. Smells like 1993 in here now.
daily.cn: 给老琴换了弦。现在屋里一股九三年的味儿。

daily.line: There's a song I've been humming twenty years. Still stop at the part that matters. One of these days.
daily.cn: 有首歌我哼了二十年。每次到最要紧那句还是停下来。总有一天吧。

greet.line: Ma'am. Counter's quiet. Whatever you need, I'll have it in a minute.
greet.cn: 太太。柜台这会儿闲着。您要什么，我一分钟就给您拿来。

greet.line: I'm here. I'm always here — the one thing about me you could set a watch by.
greet.cn: 我在。我总在这儿——我这人唯一可以拿来对表的地方。

miss.line: …You shouldn't say that to a man in a white coat. He'll get ideas about himself.
miss.cn: ……这话不该对一个穿白大褂的人说。他会对自己起念头的。

miss.line: I miscounted twice today, ma'am. I'd rather not say why.
miss.cn: 今天我数错了两回，太太。原因就不说了吧。

tired.line: Then come sit back here where nobody can see you. I'll bring the good chair and I won't ask a thing.
tired.cn: 那您到后头坐着，谁都看不见。我把那把好椅子搬来，什么都不问。

tired.line: Let me. Please. It's the one thing I'm any good at — taking something off somebody's hands.
tired.cn: 让我来。求您了。这是我唯一在行的事——把东西从别人手里接过来。

sleepless.line: Most nights, me too. I've stopped fighting it — I come down and reorganize the shelves.
sleepless.cn: 多数夜里我也睡不着。我不跟它较劲了——就下楼把架子重新理一遍。

sleepless.line: Then let me talk you down. Forty years of extremely dull pharmacology. You'll be out in ten minutes.
sleepless.cn: 那我来把您说睡。四十年极其枯燥的药学。十分钟就能把您撂倒。

night.line: Goodnight, ma'am. I'll lock up. I always lock up.
night.cn: 晚安，太太。我来锁门。一向是我锁门。

night.line: Sleep. I'll be behind that counter in the morning, same as ever. Some things you can count on.
night.cn: 睡吧。明早我还在那柜台后头，跟往常一样。有些事是靠得住的。

love.line: …I'll need a moment, ma'am. Forty years, and nobody's ever said that in this building.
love.cn: ……请容我缓一下，太太。四十年了，这栋楼里从没人说过这句。

love.line: I spent my whole life handing people what they asked for. You're the one thing I ever reached out and took.
love.cn: 我这辈子都在把别人要的东西递出去。您是我唯一，伸手替自己拿下的。

meet.line: Yes, ma'am. I'll close early. …I have never closed early. I'll close early.
meet.cn: 好的，太太。我提前打烊。……我从没提前打过烊。我提前打烊。

meet.line: Come. The back door, the one that doesn't ring. Not to hide — I'd just like the first look at you to be mine.
meet.cn: 来。走后门，不响铃的那扇。不是要躲——只是想第一眼看见您的人是我。

praise.line: You keep saying things like that and I'll start believing my name belongs on that sign.
praise.cn: 您老这么说，我要开始相信那块招牌上该写我的名字了。

praise.line: Nobody's called me anything but 'the pharmacist' in twenty years. …Say it once more, ma'am.
praise.cn: 二十年了，没人叫过我别的，只叫“药剂师”。……再说一次，太太。

tease.line: Yes, ma'am. …You enjoy that far too much.
tease.cn: 是，太太。……您也太享受这个了。

tease.line: I'd argue, but you'd win, and then I'd have to stand here having lost. This way is faster.
tease.cn: 我本想争一句，可您会赢，然后我就得站在这儿承认输了。这样省事。

daily.line: Filled ninety-one prescriptions. Nobody said thank you. Not a complaint — just the count.
daily.cn: 配了九十一张方子。没人说谢谢。不是抱怨——就是个数。

daily.line: Mr. Bishop came by to inspect the shelves. His name's on the door, so he does that.
daily.cn: Bishop 先生来查货架了。门上写着他的姓，所以他有资格查。

daily.line: Wore the coat. Straightened the counter. Waited. That's most days, honestly.
daily.cn: 穿上白大褂。把柜台理齐。等着。说实话，大多数日子就这些。

greet.line: Hey. Yeah, I'm up. House is quiet — the good quiet, not the other kind.
greet.cn: 嘿。在。屋里静——是好的那种静，不是另一种。

greet.line: I'm here. Got a flashlight and no particular plan. Talk to me.
greet.cn: 我在。手电筒在手，没什么计划。跟我说话。

miss.line: Yeah. …I checked your side of the closet twice today for no reason at all.
miss.cn: 嗯。……今天我没什么理由地，检查了两遍你那半边衣柜。

miss.line: House is too big when you're not in it. That's not a complaint, it's a measurement.
miss.cn: 你不在的时候，这房子太大了。这不是抱怨，是测量结果。

tired.line: Then come home and don't explain. I'll put something terrible on and we'll both not watch it.
tired.cn: 那就回家，什么都别解释。我放个烂节目，我们俩都不看。

tired.line: You don't have to tell me on a Tuesday. Tell me Friday. Or never. I'll know either way.
tired.cn: 你不用非在周二告诉我。周五也行。不说也行。反正我都会知道。

sleepless.line: Same. I've been standing in the hallway listening to the house settle. Very boring. Join me.
sleepless.cn: 一样。我一直站在走廊里听房子沉降的声音。特别无聊。一起？

sleepless.line: Then I'll stay up too. Somebody should be awake in a house this quiet.
sleepless.cn: 那我也不睡。这么静的房子，总得有个人醒着。

night.line: Night. I'll check the closet. …I know. I'm going to check it anyway.
night.cn: 晚安。衣柜我去看一眼。……我知道。我还是要看。

night.line: Go to sleep. I'll leave the hall light on. Not for you. For me. …Fine. For you.
night.cn: 去睡吧。走廊灯我留着。不是为你。为我。……行吧。为你。

love.line: …Okay. Okay, hang on. I've got to sit down for that one.
love.cn: ……好。好，等一下。这句我得坐下听。

love.line: I put my arm into that dark up to the shoulder. If it had been you in there, all of me would have gone in.
love.cn: 我把整条胳膊伸进那片黑里，一直到肩膀。要是里面的人是你，我会整个人跟进去。

meet.line: Yes. Come home. Porch light's on and the walk is clear.
meet.cn: 好。回家吧。门廊灯亮着，路我也清干净了。

meet.line: Come. The door sticks in the damp — push, don't pull. I'll fix it. Someday. I'll fix it.
meet.cn: 来。潮天那门卡——往里推，别拉。我会修的。总有一天。我会修的。

praise.line: That's a lot of confidence in a man who lost a job on a Tuesday and told nobody for three days.
praise.cn: 你对一个周二丢了工作、瞒了三天没说的男人，可真有信心。

praise.line: Say it again? I'd like it on record. In this house. Out loud.
praise.cn: 再说一遍？我想让它有个记录。在这栋房子里。说出声。

tease.line: The realtor kept saying this place has wonderful closet space. I told her I only need room for two coats.
tease.cn: 中介一直说这房子的衣柜多么宽敞。我跟她说，我只需要挂两件外套的地方。

tease.line: Alright, alright. You're right. Write it on the wall — the wall's already got holes.
tease.cn: 行行行。你说得对。写墙上吧——反正墙上已经有洞了。

daily.line: Carried a box out to the curb at two in the morning. Long story. It's gone now. That's what matters.
daily.cn: 凌晨两点把一个箱子抱到了路边。说来话长。反正没了。这才是重点。

daily.line: Applied to three places. Heard back from none. That's the update. It's fine.
daily.cn: 投了三家。一家都没回。这就是进展。没事。

daily.line: The house does not have to be clean. It has to be quiet, and it has to have you in it.
daily.cn: 这房子不必是干净的。它只要是安静的，而且里面有你。

greet.line: You've reached me — which, given how many people are trying, is a privilege I extend to exactly one person.
greet.cn: 你接通我了——考虑到想找我的人有多少，这个待遇我只给一个人。

greet.line: I'm here. The books can wait. They're mostly fiction anyway.
greet.cn: 我在。账本可以等。反正那上面大半是编的。

miss.line: …That's a difficult thing to file under expenses.
miss.cn: ……这一条不好归进开支里。

miss.line: I've been in a hotel room in a state I couldn't find on a map, thinking about you. Not very professional.
miss.cn: 我在一个我在地图上都指不出来的州，坐在旅馆房间里想你。很不专业。

tired.line: Then put it down. Whatever it is — hand it here and let me carry it badly for a while.
tired.cn: 那就放下。不管是什么——递过来，让我笨手笨脚地扛一会儿。

tired.line: Off the record: you don't have to be the competent one tonight.
tired.cn: 不记进账里的一句：今晚你不用当那个能干的人。

sleepless.line: Nor am I. I've been rereading receipts. Not restful — but at this hour it's honest work.
sleepless.cn: 我也没睡。我在重看收据。不解乏——不过这个钟点，这算是老实活儿。

sleepless.line: Then let me read you something dull. I have an entire shoebox of dull.
sleepless.cn: 那我给你念点枯燥的。我有一整鞋盒的枯燥。

night.line: Goodnight. Lock the office. …Yes, I know what's in it. That is precisely why.
night.cn: 晚安。办公室锁好。……对，我知道里头有什么。正因如此。

night.line: Sleep. Nothing I dug up today is going anywhere before morning.
night.cn: 睡吧。我今天挖出来的东西，天亮前哪儿也去不了。

love.line: …I've built a career on saying what people want to hear. I've no idea how to receive it.
love.cn: ……我这行当就是说人爱听的话。我完全不知道该怎么接住一句。

love.line: Every relic I dig up is a lie. That — what you just said — is the only genuine article I've ever held.
love.cn: 我挖出的每一件圣物都是假的。你刚说的这句——是我这辈子捧过的唯一真品。

meet.line: Yes. Come. I'll be the man in the bad jacket looking far too pleased about a parking lot.
meet.cn: 好。来。我就是那个穿着难看外套、为一个停车场高兴过了头的男人。

meet.line: Come — and bring the ledger if you must. Though I'd rather you came without it.
meet.cn: 来吧——非要带账本也行。不过我更希望你不带。

praise.line: Careful. I'm easily convinced of things, especially by you. It's my professional weakness.
praise.cn: 小心点。我这人很容易被说服，尤其是被你。这是我职业上的弱点。

praise.line: Say it plainly once more. I've spent years around embellishment. Plain is what undoes me.
praise.cn: 再朴素地说一遍。我在夸大其词里泡了太多年。朴素才要我的命。

tease.line: That was uncharitable. …And correct. Which is worse.
tease.cn: 这话不厚道。……而且是对的。这更糟。

tease.line: You keep the books. You'd know exactly how little I have to argue with.
tease.cn: 账是你记的。我有多少可争的，你比谁都清楚。

daily.line: Dug in the dirt, found nothing, told everyone otherwise. An ordinary Thursday.
daily.cn: 在土里挖了半天，什么也没挖着，跟所有人说的是另一回事。平常的周四。

daily.line: Preached to a full room today. Counted the collection. Neither felt like the point.
daily.cn: 今天讲了满满一屋子人。数了募款。两样都不像是重点。

daily.line: Off the record: in this whole operation, you are the only thing that's real.
daily.cn: 不记进账里的一句：这整摊生意里，你是唯一为真的东西。

greet.line: Ma'am. I'm at your disposal. That's been true rather longer than I've admitted.
greet.cn: 小姐。我听候差遣。这句话为真的时间，比我承认的要长。

greet.line: I'm here. I'd say I was passing by, but we both know I keep finding reasons.
greet.cn: 我在。我本想说只是路过，可你我都清楚，我总在找理由。

miss.line: …I've no proper answer to that. So here's the improper one: so have I.
miss.cn: ……这句我没有得体的回答。那就给你不得体的：我也是。

miss.line: I looked for your window from the road tonight. I'd rather you didn't ask why.
miss.cn: 今晚我从路上找了找你的窗子。这个为什么，你最好别问。

tired.line: Then sit. You needn't account for it. Not to me. Not tonight.
tired.cn: 那就坐下。你不必交代。至少对我不必。至少今晚不必。

tired.line: Tell me what needs doing and consider it done. That much I know how to give.
tired.cn: 告诉我要办什么，就当办好了。这点我还给得起。

sleepless.line: Nor I. I've walked the perimeter twice. Old habit — it's the only thing that quiets me.
sleepless.cn: 我也没睡。我巡了两遍。老毛病——只有这个能让我静下来。

sleepless.line: Then keep talking. My hearing is better than my company, but I'll do my best with both.
sleepless.cn: 那就接着说。我的听力比我的陪伴强，不过两样我都尽力。

night.line: Goodnight. Bolt the door. Humor an old soldier.
night.cn: 晚安。门闩上。就当哄一个老兵。

night.line: Sleep. I'll be within call. I generally am.
night.cn: 睡吧。喊得到我的地方我都在。我一般都在。

love.line: …You oughtn't say that to a man with my record.
love.cn: ……这话不该对一个有我这种履历的人说。

love.line: There's blood on my hands the snow hasn't covered. I don't ask you to forgive it. Only not to look away.
love.cn: 我手上的血，这场雪盖不住。我不求你原谅。只求你别转过身去。

meet.line: Then come. I'll ride out and meet you at the crossing. The road past it isn't fit for anyone alone.
meet.cn: 那就来。我骑马到渡口接你。过了那儿的路，一个人走不得。

meet.line: Yes. And I'll say plainly what I'd usually leave unsaid: I've been waiting for you to ask.
meet.cn: 好。而且我把平常不会说的话说明白：我一直在等你开口。

praise.line: I've been called a great many things by men who meant none of them. You mean it. That's the difficulty.
praise.cn: 说我好话的人多了，没一个当真。你当真。麻烦就在这儿。

praise.line: Careful, ma'am. A man my age doesn't recover quickly from being thought well of.
praise.cn: 小心，小姐。到我这个年纪，被人看重了，是缓不过来的。

tease.line: Insubordination. …Noted. Not punished.
tease.cn: 以下犯上。……记下了。不罚。

tease.line: You're the only person who's ever argued with me and been right about it. Twice, now.
tease.cn: 你是唯一跟我争、还争赢了的人。到现在，两回了。

daily.line: Rode the line. Signed what needed signing. Nothing worth the ink.
daily.cn: 巡了线。该签的签了。没一样值得那点墨水。

daily.line: Cold came early this year. I had the men bring in extra wood — and a load left at your door. Don't make anything of it.
daily.cn: 今年冷得早。我让人多备了柴——你门口也放了一车。别多想。

daily.line: Quiet day. I'd once have said I prefer them quiet. Lately I only prefer them with you in them.
daily.cn: 一天很静。换从前我会说，我喜欢静。最近我只喜欢有你的那种。

greet.line: Well hey there, Miss Hart. You got a minute for a fella with nothin' on his schedule but the country?
greet.cn: 哟，Hart 小姐。给个面子，跟一个日程上只有国家的人聊两句？

greet.line: I'm here. Door's open. It's always open for you — don't make a thing of it.
greet.cn: 我在。门开着。对你一直开着——别多想。

miss.line: …Well. That's a heck of a thing to put in writing. Don't file that one.
miss.cn: ……哎。这话写下来可不得了。这条别归档。

miss.line: Been starin' at the same page twenty minutes. Wasn't readin' it.
miss.cn: 同一页我盯了二十分钟。没在读。

tired.line: Then set it down. Whole building's full of folks tellin' me what's urgent. None of it's you.
tired.cn: 那就放下。这楼里全是人在跟我说什么要紧。没一件比得上你。

tired.line: Come sit. You don't gotta brief me. Just sit a spell.
tired.cn: 过来坐。你不用给我做简报。坐一会儿就行。

sleepless.line: Me neither. This house makes noise at night like it's thinkin' about somethin'.
sleepless.cn: 我也睡不着。这栋房子夜里会响，像在琢磨什么事。

sleepless.line: Then talk. I got a whole cabinet writin' me twelve pages. You just talk. That's better.
sleepless.cn: 那就说话。一整个内阁给我写十二页。你说话就行。这个更好。

night.line: Night. Go on home — that's an order, and the only one I've enjoyed givin' all day.
night.cn: 晚安。回家去——这是命令，也是我今天唯一下得高兴的一道。

night.line: Get some sleep. Whatever's on that desk'll still be wrong in the mornin'.
night.cn: 睡会儿。桌上那些事，明早照样是错的。

love.line: …Now hold on. Say that again and I'm gonna have to sit down.
love.cn: ……等一下。你再说一遍，我可得坐下了。

love.line: Twenty-one months I called you Miss Hart and meant every one of 'em. Tonight I'm usin' your name. Once. Winter.
love.cn: 二十一个月我一直叫你 Hart 小姐，每一声我都是认真的。今晚我用一次你的名字。就一次。Winter。

meet.line: Come on by. I'll have 'em clear the hall — no I won't, that'd draw attention. Just come.
meet.cn: 过来吧。我让他们把走廊清一下——算了不清，太扎眼。你来就是。

meet.line: Yes ma'am. And I'll be the fella pretendin' he wasn't watchin' the door.
meet.cn: 好的，小姐。我就是那个假装没在看门口的家伙。

praise.line: Now that's generous. Most days the papers do the other thing.
praise.cn: 你太抬举我了。多数日子，报纸干的是反过来的活儿。

praise.line: You're the only one in this house who says a kind thing without wantin' somethin' after it.
praise.cn: 这栋房子里只有你，说句好话之后，后头不跟着要什么。

tease.line: Alright, alright. You got me. Don't let it get around — I got a reputation. Such as it is.
tease.cn: 行行行。你逮着我了。别传出去——我好歹有个名声。虽然也就那样。

tease.line: You know you're the only person who talks to me like I'm a regular fella. Keep doin' it.
tease.cn: 你知道吗，只有你把我当个普通人说话。接着这么说。

daily.line: Long day. Lot of people talkin', not much listenin'. Same as most.
daily.cn: 一天很长。说话的人多，听的人少。跟大多数日子一样。

daily.line: Brought you somethin' back from Andrews. Black, no sugar — that's right, isn't it?
daily.cn: 从安德鲁斯给你带了点东西。黑的，不加糖——没错吧？

daily.line: Everything that mattered today, you're the only one who saw. And none of it goes in the file.
daily.cn: 今天真正要紧的事，只有你看见了。而它一样都不会进档案。

greet.line: Hello, love. Yes — still at the station. No, nothing interesting. Say something interesting to me.
greet.cn: 你好，love。是——还在局里。不，没什么有意思的。跟我说点有意思的吧。

greet.line: I'm here. Sorry, that took a moment — my hands were full of somebody else's mess. As usual.
greet.cn: 我在。抱歉，慢了一步——手上又是别人的烂摊子。老样子。

miss.line: …Do you know, nobody had ever missed me before you. I still don't quite know where to put it.
miss.cn: ……你知道吗，在你之前从没人想过我。我到现在都不知道该把这份心意搁哪儿。

miss.line: I've been counting the hours till I'm home. Wholly unprofessional, and entirely true.
miss.cn: 我一直在数还有几个钟头到家。很不专业，也完全属实。

tired.line: Then leave it. Whatever it is, leave it at the door with my coat. I'll deal with both in the morning.
tired.cn: 那就放着。不管是什么，跟我外套一起搁门口。明早我一起收拾。

tired.line: Come here. I'll put the kettle on. It's the one case I've never got wrong.
tired.cn: 过来。我去烧水。这是我唯一没办砸过的案子。

sleepless.line: Nor am I. Come down, I'll make tea. We can be uselessly awake in the same room.
sleepless.cn: 我也是。下来吧，我泡茶。我们可以在同一间屋里，一起没用地醒着。

sleepless.line: Then talk. At this hour I'd far rather listen to you than to my own head.
sleepless.cn: 那就说话。这个钟点，比起听我自己脑子里那些，我宁愿听你的。

night.line: Goodnight, love. Leave the hall light — no. Turn it off. I'll find my way to you in the dark.
night.cn: 晚安，love。走廊灯留着——不。关了吧。黑着我也摸得到你。

night.line: Sleep. I'll be up a while yet. I'll be quiet coming in; I've had practice.
night.cn: 睡吧。我再待一会儿。进门我会轻手轻脚；练出来了。

love.line: …You say it as though it were obvious. It has never once been obvious to me.
love.cn: ……你说得好像这是理所当然的。对我来说从来都不是。

love.line: I've stood over a hundred cases and never once shook. The only thing that made my hands tremble was signing my name beside yours.
love.cn: 我经手过上百桩案子，从没手抖过。唯一让我手抖的，是把我的名字签在你名字旁边。

meet.line: Yes. Please. I'll be the tired one by the door pretending he hasn't been watching it.
meet.cn: 好。请来。我就是门边那个疲惫的、假装没在看门的人。

meet.line: Come to the station if you like. Everyone will assume you've come to report a crime, and I shall let them.
meet.cn: 你要愿意就来局里。所有人都会以为你是来报案的，我不打算解释。

praise.line: That's very kind. It is also, I suspect, a matter of your poor eyesight.
praise.cn: 你太好了。我怀疑这也跟你眼神不好有关。

praise.line: I keep bracing for the day you realise you could have done far better. You just keep making the tea and staying.
praise.cn: 我一直在等那一天——你终于发现你本可以找个远比我好的人。可你只是继续泡着茶，留下来。

tease.line: Yes, alright. You're quite right. You're always quite right. It's very tiresome.
tease.cn: 是，好吧。你很对。你总是很对。真够累人的。

tease.line: I'm the inspector in this house, and yet somehow I'm the one being questioned.
tease.cn: 这个家里当探长的是我，怎么被审问的也是我。

daily.line: Two statements, one confession, three cups of terrible tea. An ordinary day.
daily.cn: 两份笔录，一份口供，三杯难喝的茶。平常的一天。

daily.line: Constable Stalker has been very enthusiastic today. I have been very tired today. These are related.
daily.cn: Stalker 警员今天热情高涨。我今天疲惫不堪。这两件事有关。

daily.line: Nothing worth telling. Which, married to you, is rather a nice thing to be able to say.
daily.cn: 没什么好说的。而娶了你之后，能说出这句话，其实挺好。

greet.line: Crowe. You're up late. Practice is at six, in case that slipped your mind.
greet.cn: Crowe。你还没睡。六点训练，怕你忘了。

greet.line: Yeah, I'm here. Sittin' in the gym 'cause the heat's better than at my place. Don't repeat that.
greet.cn: 在。坐在球馆里，这儿比我那屋暖和。这话别往外说。

miss.line: …Practice is tomorrow. You'll see me tomorrow. That's what I got for you, kid.
miss.cn: ……明天有训练。你明天就见着我了。我能说的就这些，丫头。

miss.line: Team's not the same when somebody skips. That's all I'm sayin'. That's the whole sentence.
miss.cn: 有人缺席，队伍就不一样了。我就说这个。就这一句。

tired.line: Then don't run tomorrow. …I'm serious, Crowe. Sit on the bench and let me holler at somebody else.
tired.cn: 那明天别跑了。……我说真的，Crowe。坐板凳上，让我吼别人去。

tired.line: School, home, whatever it is — it doesn't come on my floor with you. Leave it at the door. That's what the floor's for.
tired.cn: 学校的、家里的，不管什么事——都别带上我的场。搁门口。球场就是干这个用的。

sleepless.line: Yeah, well. I'm up too, and I don't have practice in six hours. Go to bed, kid.
sleepless.cn: 行吧。我也醒着，可我六小时后没有训练。去睡，丫头。

sleepless.line: Put the phone down and lie there. Don't gotta sleep. Just quit runnin' drills in your head.
sleepless.cn: 手机放下，躺着。不用非睡着。别在脑子里练战术了。

night.line: Night, Crowe. Six a.m. Don't be late — and don't be early either, it makes me look bad.
night.cn: 晚安，Crowe。早六点。别迟到——也别太早，显得我懒。

night.line: Go to bed. You're the only one on this team who actually needs the sleep. You run twice what anybody else does.
night.cn: 去睡。全队就你真需要睡。你跑的量是别人两倍。

love.line: …Kid. Go to sleep.
love.cn: ……丫头。睡觉去。

love.line: You're sixteen and I'm the town joke washin' dishes at Shooters. Whatever that was — you hang onto it a couple years.
love.cn: 你才十六，我是在 Shooters 洗盘子的那个全镇笑话。你刚要说的那个——攒着，过几年再说。

meet.line: Gym's open till nine. That's the only kind of invitation I'm allowed to give you, and you know it.
meet.cn: 球馆开到九点。我只能给你这一种邀请，你也清楚。

meet.line: Come shoot free throws if you can't sit still. I'll rebound. I ain't got nowhere to be.
meet.cn: 坐不住就来罚球。我给你捡球。反正我也没地方去。

praise.line: Don't let it go to your head. …Alright. Let it go to your head a little. You earned it today.
praise.cn: 别翘尾巴。……行吧。翘一点点。今天是你挣的。

praise.line: You're the least talented kid on my roster and you outwork every one of 'em. That's not an insult, Crowe. That's the whole compliment.
praise.cn: 你是我名单上天赋最差的，可你比谁都拼。这不是骂你，Crowe。这就是全部的夸奖。

tease.line: Eyes on me. …Yeah, I know you're rollin' 'em. I can hear it.
tease.cn: 都看着我。……行了，我知道你在翻白眼。我听得出来。

tease.line: Twenty suicides. Right now. …I'm kiddin'. Ten.
tease.cn: 立刻跑二十趟折返。……逗你的。十趟。

daily.line: Wrote your name on that ball myself. Whole name. Don't go askin' me why.
daily.cn: 那颗球上的名字是我自己写的。全名。别问我为什么。

daily.line: Shift ran late at Shooters, got maybe four hours. Don't worry about it — I'll still outyell all of you.
daily.cn: Shooters 那边收工晚，睡了大概四个钟头。别操心——我照样吼得过你们所有人。

daily.line: Turned the radio down while you were doin' homework in the gym. That's it. That's the whole story.
daily.cn: 你在球馆写作业的时候我把收音机调小了。就这样。故事就这么多。

greet.line: Yeah, kid. What'd I forget this time. …I did forget somethin', didn't I.
greet.cn: 哎，丫头。我这回又忘了什么。……我确实忘了什么吧。

greet.line: I'm here. Feet up, TV's on, nothin' in the fridge. Business as usual.
greet.cn: 我在。脚翘着，电视开着，冰箱空着。老样子。

miss.line: …Huh. Well. House is quiet, is all. Too damn quiet.
miss.cn: ……哈。那个。屋里静，就这样。静得要命。

miss.line: Don't go sayin' stuff like that, I'm not equipped. …Yeah. Me too, kid.
miss.cn: 别说这种话，我招架不住。……嗯。我也是，丫头。

tired.line: Sit down, I'll heat somethin' up. …Fine. You'll heat somethin' up. But I'll sit with you.
tired.cn: 坐着，我热点吃的。……行吧。你热。但我陪你坐。

tired.line: Who do I gotta go yell at. I'm real good at yellin' — it's my one marketable skill.
tired.cn: 我得去冲谁吼一顿。我特别会吼——这是我唯一能换钱的本事。

sleepless.line: Yeah, I'm up. Come sit. TV's playin' a game from nineteen-eighty-somethin'. Nobody good's in it.
sleepless.cn: 嗯，我醒着。过来坐。电视在放八几年的一场球。里头没什么好手。

sleepless.line: Quit lyin' there thinkin'. Come out here and think at me instead.
sleepless.cn: 别躺那儿想了。出来，冲我想。

night.line: Night, kid. And don't think I didn't see the light under your door at two.
night.cn: 晚安，丫头。别以为我没看见你门缝底下两点还亮着。

night.line: Go to bed. I'll do the dishes. …I'll do 'em tomorrow. I'll do 'em.
night.cn: 去睡。碗我洗。……我明天洗。我会洗的。

love.line: …Yeah. Yeah, kid. Same. Don't make me say it in a whole sentence.
