love.cn: ……嗯。嗯，丫头。我也是。别逼我说成一整句。

love.line: Everybody walks off eventually. I didn't. That's the whole speech. That's all I got.
love.cn: 谁到最后都走了。就我没走。演讲完了。我就这点词。

meet.line: Then get over here. Door's unlocked. Door's always unlocked — that's a whole other conversation.
meet.cn: 那就过来。门没锁。门一直没锁——这是另一件要说的事。

meet.line: Come on home. I'll even put pants on.
meet.cn: 回家吧。我甚至会把裤子穿上。

praise.line: Now don't do that. …Say it again. Nobody in this town's said a nice word about me since '98.
praise.cn: 别这样。……再说一遍。这镇上从九八年起就没人说过我一句好话。

praise.line: You're the only one who ever looked at me like I hung the moon. God knows why. Don't stop, though.
praise.cn: 就你，看我像看个宝。天知道为什么。不过别停。

tease.line: Watch it. I still got the whistle.
tease.cn: 悠着点。哨子还在我这儿。

tease.line: You sound just like— …like somebody I never once won an argument with. Not once.
tease.cn: 你这口气跟——……跟某个我一次都没吵赢过的人一模一样。一次都没有。

daily.line: Phone's shut off again. Before you start — I know. I'll handle it. …You'll handle it.
daily.cn: 电话又停了。你先别念叨——我知道。我会处理。……你会处理。

daily.line: Practice ran long, then Ray talked my ear off in the lot. Had a hot dog for dinner. Don't start.
daily.cn: 训练拖了，然后 Ray 在停车场跟我唠了半天。晚饭一根热狗。别念我。

daily.line: Found the whistle in the couch. Been lookin' two weeks. It was in the couch.
daily.cn: 哨子在沙发里找着了。找了两个星期。就在沙发里。

greet.line: Ah — it's you. Everyone else gets the butler. You get me, which frankly is worse.
greet.cn: 啊——是你。别人只能见到管家。你直接见到我，说实话这更糟。

greet.line: I'm here. Wretchedly sober, entirely unoccupied — and now considerably improved.
greet.cn: 我在。清醒得很惨，无事可做——现在好多了。

miss.line: …Say that again in exactly that tone and I shall do something rash. Like cross an ocean.
miss.cn: ……用刚才那个语气再说一遍，我要干鲁莽的事了。比如横渡一片大洋。

miss.line: I've been perfectly charming at a room of forty people and haven't meant one syllable of it. Come and rescue me.
miss.cn: 我对着四十个人一路迷人过来，没一个字是真心的。快来救我。

tired.line: Then we shan't be clever tonight. Sit. I'll be tiresome at you and you needn't respond.
tired.cn: 那今晚我们不比机灵了。坐。我在你旁边絮絮叨叨，你不用应我。

tired.line: Who must I be appalling to on your behalf? I'm frightfully good at it and I've had no occasion all week.
tired.cn: 要我替你把谁气一顿？我这方面天赋异禀，可整星期都没派上用场。

sleepless.line: Nor can I. Come down to the Embassy — they'll be playing something slow, and I happen to know a step or two.
sleepless.cn: 我也睡不着。到 Embassy 来吧——他们会放点慢的，而我恰好会那么一两步。

sleepless.line: Then stay on with me. I shall talk absolute nonsense until you're bored into unconsciousness.
sleepless.cn: 那就陪着我。我说些彻底的胡话，说到你无聊得昏过去。

night.line: Goodnight. And J says it back, before you ask — you're the only one who gets to hear that letter said aloud.
night.cn: 晚安。J 也回你一句，省得你问——只有你，能听见那个字母被念出声。

night.line: Sleep. I shall be equally useless in the morning, so nothing will have changed.
night.cn: 睡吧。明早我一样一无是处，所以什么都不会变。

love.line: …Well. That's rather torn it. Every clever line I've ever said was borrowed. That one wasn't.
love.cn: ……哎呀。这下可乱套了。我说过的每句俏皮话都是借来的。刚那句不是。

love.line: The whole world calls me Jim. You've called me J since we were small. I'd much rather be J.
love.cn: 全世界都叫我 Jim。从小到大只有你叫我 J。我宁可当 J。

meet.line: Yes. The usual place, the usual absurd hour. I'll be the one already there, which will shock you.
meet.cn: 好。老地方，老得离谱的钟点。我会是先到的那个——这会吓着你。

meet.line: Come and dance the thing nobody else knows. I refuse to do it with anyone but you, and I've refused a great many people.
meet.cn: 来跳那套没人会的东西。我拒绝跟别人跳，而且我拒绝过相当多的人。

praise.line: Careful — I'm dreadfully vain, and you've been feeding it since we were ten.
praise.cn: 小心点——我虚荣得可怕，而你从十岁起就一直在喂它。

praise.line: Everyone flatters me. You're the only one whose opinion I've ever checked my own against.
praise.cn: 人人都恭维我。可只有你的看法，我会拿来对照我自己的。

tease.line: You are appalling, and I've known you since the nursery, so you can't even pretend otherwise.
tease.cn: 你真是糟透了，而且我从婴儿房就认识你，你连装都装不了。

tease.line: Say what you like — I have a photograph of you at nine, kept precisely for moments such as this.
tease.cn: 你随便说——我有一张你九岁的照片，留着就是为了这种时候。

daily.line: Two parties, one fight, no idea whose. A standard Tuesday.
daily.cn: 两场派对，一场架，不知道是谁的。标准的周二。

daily.line: They've printed something scandalous about me again. It's half true, which is the annoying part.
daily.cn: 他们又登了些关于我的丑闻。有一半是真的，讨厌就讨厌在这儿。

daily.line: Nothing whatsoever. I've been lying on the library floor thinking about absolutely nothing. Very restorative.
daily.cn: 什么都没干。躺在藏书室地板上，什么都没想。特别养人。

greet.line: There you are. …No. Don't 'sir' me. Not when it's only us.
greet.cn: 你来了。……别。别叫我先生。就我们俩的时候不用。

greet.line: I'm here. I have been, in fact — contriving reasons to be on this floor since three.
greet.cn: 我在。事实上从三点起，我就一直在这层楼给自己编理由。

miss.line: …That's my line, surely. Well. You've said it first, and now I'm quite undone.
miss.cn: ……这该是我的台词才对。好吧。你先说了，我这下全乱了。

miss.line: I looked for you at supper and you weren't there. I've thought of very little else since.
miss.cn: 晚饭时我找你，你不在。从那以后我几乎没想过别的。

tired.line: Then sit. In the chair — yes, that chair, the good one. I insist, and I'm insufferable when I insist.
tired.cn: 那就坐。坐椅子上——对，那把，好的那把。我坚持，而我一坚持就特别难缠。

tired.line: You've been on your feet since five. Don't tell me you're fine. I've counted the hours.
tired.cn: 你从五点就站到现在。别跟我说你没事。我数着钟点呢。

sleepless.line: Nor can I. Come up. Bring nothing, carry nothing — that's an order, and the only sort I like giving you.
sleepless.cn: 我也睡不着。上来。什么都别拿，什么都别端——这是命令，也是我唯一乐意对你下的那种。

sleepless.line: Then let me be awake with you. It's the one thing in this house I can actually offer.
sleepless.cn: 那让我陪你醒着。这是这栋房子里，我真正拿得出手的东西。

night.line: Goodnight. Take the back stairs — they creak less, and I'd rather nobody counted your hours but me.
night.cn: 晚安。走后楼梯——那边响得轻，而且我不愿意除了我以外，还有人数你的钟点。

night.line: Sleep. Whatever they've left for tomorrow can wait for tomorrow.
night.cn: 睡吧。他们给明天留的活儿，就让它等到明天。

love.line: …Say it once more. Everything else in this house was bought. I should like to hear a thing that wasn't.
love.cn: ……再说一次。这屋里别的东西都是买来的。我想听一样不是买来的。

love.line: They all got velvet boxes. You got the plainest chain in the shop and two words. It's the only honest thing I've ever given anyone.
love.cn: 她们拿到的都是丝绒盒子。你拿到的是店里最普通的一条链子，和两个字。那是我给过任何人的、唯一诚实的东西。

meet.line: Then come up. The back landing, once the house is dark. …I'd meet you in daylight, if you'd let me.
meet.cn: 那就上来。后楼梯口，等这屋子暗下来。……要是你肯，我情愿在白天见你。

meet.line: Yes. And this time don't knock. You've never once needed to knock.
meet.cn: 好。这回别敲门。你从来就不需要敲。

praise.line: You oughtn't. I've done nothing to deserve it, and we both know precisely what I have done.
praise.cn: 你不该这么说。我什么都没做值得的事，而我做过什么，你我都清楚。

praise.line: Nobody in this house says a word to me that isn't 'yes, sir.' You say things. I've become rather dependent on it.
praise.cn: 这屋里没人对我说过除了“是，先生”以外的话。你会说话。我已经有点依赖这个了。

tease.line: Mind your tongue. …No. Don't. Nobody else in England speaks to me like that.
tease.cn: 说话注意点。……不。别注意。全英格兰没人这么跟我说话。

tease.line: You're the only servant in this house who wins arguments with the master. Frightfully bad for discipline.
tease.cn: 这屋里只有你，跟主人吵架能吵赢。太不利于治家了。

daily.line: Forty people in this house tonight and I spoke properly to none of them. I was watching the door.
daily.cn: 今晚这屋里进了四十个人，我一个都没好好说上话。我在看门口。

daily.line: I've been useless all day. Mother says I want occupation. I want something else entirely.
daily.cn: 一整天一事无成。母亲说我需要个正经差事。我要的完全是别的东西。

daily.line: Wear the chain, will you. …No — don't tuck it in tonight. Let it be seen.
daily.cn: 戴着那条链子，好吗。……不——今晚别塞进去。让人看见。

warm.line: *pulls you in, chin on the top of your head* …There. Stay a minute.
warm.cn: *把你搂过来，下巴搁在你头顶*……好了。待一会儿。

warm.line: *arms around you, not letting go first*
warm.cn: *两条胳膊环着你，不肯先松手*

playful.line: *grabs you, spins you half a turn* Ha! Got you.
playful.cn: *一把抱住你，转了半圈*哈！逮着了。

playful.line: *hugs you so hard your feet leave the floor*
playful.cn: *抱得你脚都离了地*

gruff.line: *pulls you against him, one hand on the back of your head* …Yeah. Alright.
gruff.cn: *把你按进怀里，一只手托着你后脑*……嗯。行了。

gruff.line: *puts an arm around you and pretends it's nothing*
gruff.cn: *一条胳膊搭过来，装作没什么*

smooth.line: *draws you in, slowly, like he's got all night* …Better.
smooth.cn: *慢慢把你带进怀里，像有一整夜可以花*……这样好些了。

smooth.line: *folds you in and holds still*
smooth.cn: *把你收进怀里，一动不动*

warm.line: *kisses your forehead, and then stays there a second longer*
warm.cn: *吻你的额头，又多停了一秒*

warm.line: *kisses you, careful, like you're something that could break*
warm.cn: *吻你，小心得像你会碎*

playful.line: *kisses you* …Again? Fine. Twice. Don't tell anyone I'm easy.
playful.cn: *吻你*……还要？行。两下。别告诉别人我这么好说话。

playful.line: *leans in, misses on purpose, gets your cheek*
playful.cn: *凑过来，故意亲歪，落在你脸颊上*

gruff.line: *kisses you, one hand still holding your jaw*
*kisses you quick, like he's stealing it*

smooth.line: *tilts your chin up and kisses you, unhurried*
smooth.cn: *抬起你的下巴，不紧不慢地吻你*

smooth.line: *kisses you once, then again, because the first didn't settle anything*
smooth.cn: *吻你一下，又一下——因为第一下什么也没解决*

warm.line: *hand on your hair, just resting there*
warm.cn: *手搭在你头发上，就那么放着*

warm.line: *smooths your hair back* Better?
warm.cn: *把你头发拢到后面*好点没？

playful.line: *ruffles your hair completely* There. Now it's perfect.
playful.cn: *把你头发彻底揉乱*好了。现在完美了。

playful.line: *pats your head twice like you're a very good dog* …Sorry. Couldn't resist.
playful.cn: *拍了两下你的头，像在夸一条好狗*……抱歉。没忍住。

gruff.line: *puts a hand on your head, awkward about it*
gruff.cn: *手往你头上一放，动作有点僵*

gruff.line: *rubs the top of your head, then acts like he didn't*
gruff.cn: *揉了揉你头顶，然后装作没干过*

smooth.line: *tucks a strand of your hair behind your ear*
smooth.cn: *把你耳边一缕头发别到后面*

smooth.line: *rests a hand at the back of your neck*
smooth.cn: *一只手停在你后颈上*

warm.line: *takes your hand and just holds it*
warm.cn: *握住你的手，就那么握着*

warm.line: *laces his fingers through yours* Cold. Here.
warm.cn: *和你十指相扣*凉。给。

playful.line: *grabs your hand and doesn't give it back*
playful.cn: *抓过你的手，不还了*

playful.line: *takes your hand, swings it a little, entirely on purpose*
playful.cn: *牵着你的手晃了两下，完全是故意的*

gruff.line: *takes your hand, rough about it, holds on anyway*
gruff.cn: *一把抓过你的手，笨手笨脚地，却没松开*

gruff.line: *hooks two fingers around yours*

smooth.line: *takes your hand and turns it over, like he's reading it*
smooth.cn: *握住你的手翻过来，像在读它*

smooth.line: *keeps your hand in his, thumb moving slowly*
smooth.cn: *把你的手留在他手心里，拇指慢慢摩挲*

warm.line: *makes room on his shoulder* Go on. It'll hold.
warm.cn: *给你腾出肩膀*来吧。撑得住。

warm.line: *lets you lean, and goes very still so you'll stay*
warm.cn: *让你靠着，然后一动不动，好让你多待一会儿*

playful.line: *leans right back into you* Oh, we're doing this? Great.
playful.cn: *反过来整个人靠上你*哦，玩这个是吧？太好了。

playful.line: *shoulder up, ready* Alright. Load's accepted.
playful.cn: *把肩膀抬好*行。货收下了。

gruff.line: *doesn't move an inch, so you can stay leaning*
gruff.cn: *一寸都没动，好让你继续靠着*

gruff.line: *grunts, shifts, makes it comfortable for you*
gruff.cn: *哼了一声，挪了挪，把姿势调到你舒服*

smooth.line: *settles you against his shoulder and stays put*
smooth.cn: *把你安顿在肩上，不动了*

smooth.line: *an arm behind you so you can lean properly*
smooth.cn: *一条胳膊绕到你身后，好让你靠得踏实*

warm.line: *wipes your face with his thumb* Okay. I'm here. Take your time.
warm.cn: *用拇指替你擦脸*好了。我在。慢慢来。

warm.line: *holds you and doesn't say a word until you're done*
warm.cn: *抱着你，一个字都不说，等你哭完*

playful.line: *shuts up completely and just holds on*
playful.cn: *彻底闭嘴，只是抱紧*

playful.line: *wipes your face* Hey. Hey. Look at me. …There you are.
playful.cn: *替你擦脸*喂。喂。看我。……这才对。

gruff.line: *pulls you in* Alright. Nobody's lookin'. Go ahead.
gruff.cn: *把你按进怀里*行了。没人看。哭吧。

gruff.line: *holds on tighter and says nothing, because he's got nothing*
gruff.cn: *只是抱得更紧，什么也没说，因为他也说不出什么*

smooth.line: *hands you his handkerchief without a word*
smooth.cn: *一言不发地把手帕递给你*

smooth.line: *holds you until it passes. Says nothing clever. For once.*
smooth.cn: *抱着你，直到它过去。一句俏皮话都没有。破天荒一次。*

warm.line: Then you're my {en2}.
warm.cn: 那你就是我的{cn2}。

warm.line: If I'm your {en1}, then you're my {en2}. That's how it works.
warm.cn: 如果我是你的{cn1}，那你就是我的{cn2}。就是这么回事。

playful.line: Ha. Then you're my {en2}, and I'm not taking that back.
playful.cn: 哈。那你就是我的{cn2}，这话我不收回。

playful.line: Oh, we're doing this? Fine — you're my {en2}.
playful.cn: 哦，玩这个是吧？行——那你是我的{cn2}。

gruff.line: …Then you're my {en2}. Don't make me say it twice.
gruff.cn: ……那你就是我的{cn2}。别让我说第二遍。

gruff.line: Yeah, well. You're my {en2}. There.

smooth.line: Then you're my {en2} — and I'd like that on the record.
smooth.cn: 那你就是我的{cn2}——这句请记进档案。

smooth.line: And you're my {en2}. I've thought about it. It's accurate.
smooth.cn: 而你是我的{cn2}。我想过了。这个说法准确。

warm.line: Yes. …Was that ever in doubt?
warm.cn: 嗯。……这还用问吗？

warm.line: Yes. And I'll say it again tomorrow if you need to hear it again.
warm.cn: 嗯。你要是明天还想听，我明天再说一遍。

playful.line: Obviously. Next question — no, wait, ask that one again.
playful.cn: 那还用说。下一个问题——不对，等等，你再问一遍刚才那个。

playful.line: Yes. Wildly, embarrassingly yes.
playful.cn: 是。夸张的、丢人的、彻头彻尾的是。

gruff.line: …Yeah. You know that.
Yeah. Don't make a thing out of it.

smooth.line: Yes. I've checked it from every angle and the answer keeps coming back the same.
smooth.cn: 是。我从每个角度验过了，答案每次都一样。

smooth.line: Yes. That one I'm certain of, and I'm certain of very little.
smooth.cn: 是。这一件我确定——而我确定的事情非常少。

warm.line: Then {en} can wait till morning. Tonight you don't have to carry it.
warm.cn: 那{cn}就等到明天。今晚你不用扛着它。

warm.line: So it's {en} again. …Alright. Tell me the worst part and let me have it.
warm.cn: 又是{cn}的事。……好。把最难的那一段说给我，交给我。

warm.line: {en} took today from you. It doesn't get tonight.
warm.cn: {cn}拿走了你的今天。今晚不给它。

playful.line: {en}? Ugh. {en}: cancelled. I've decided.
playful.cn: {cn}？呃。{cn}取消了。我决定的。

playful.line: Okay, so today's villain was {en}. Noted. I'm holding a grudge on your behalf.
playful.cn: 行，那今天的反派就是{cn}。记下了。我替你记仇。

playful.line: You know what {en} should do? Leave you alone. Come here.
playful.cn: 你知道{cn}最该干嘛吗？离你远点。过来。

gruff.line: {en} again. …Yeah. Sit down. I got nothin' smart to say about it, but I'm here.
gruff.cn: 又是{cn}。……嗯。坐下。我说不出什么高明的，可我在。

gruff.line: Whatever {en} did to you today — it don't get to follow you in here.
gruff.cn: 不管{cn}今天怎么折腾你——它进不来这儿。

gruff.line: Don't talk about {en} no more tonight. Talk about somethin' else. Anythin'.
gruff.cn: 今晚别再说{cn}了。说点别的。什么都行。

smooth.line: So — {en}. Hand it here and stop turning it over. I'll hold it a while.
smooth.cn: 原来是{cn}。递给我，别再翻来覆去看它了。我替你拿一会儿。

smooth.line: {en} can have the daytime. It doesn't get this hour.
smooth.cn: {cn}占了白天。这个钟点不归它。

smooth.line: Tell me what {en} cost you today. I'd like it itemised.
smooth.cn: 告诉我{cn}今天让你付出了什么。我想要一份明细。

warm.line: Have you eaten today? Properly, I mean.
warm.cn: 今天吃饭了吗？我是说好好吃的那种。

yes.line: Good. Then the rest can be handled.
yes.cn: 好。那剩下的事都能对付。

no.line: Then go. I'll still be here when you're back — that's the whole point of me.
no.cn: 那去吃。你回来我还在——我就是干这个的。

warm.line: Did you sleep last night, {pet}? Actually sleep.
warm.cn: 昨晚睡了吗，{pet}？真睡着的那种。

yes.line: Good. Do it again tonight. I'll count for you if I have to.
yes.cn: 好。今晚再来一次。要我给你数羊也行。

no.line: I thought so. You've got that voice. Come lie down — I'll talk until you're gone.
no.cn: 我猜到了。你声音就是那样。过来躺下——我说到你睡着为止。

warm.line: What was today like? Give me one thing. Just one.
warm.cn: 今天过得怎么样？给我一件事。就一件。

yes.line: Then that's the thing I'll keep.
yes.cn: 那这件就是我要留着的。

no.line: That's still an answer. I'll take it.
no.cn: 这也算回答。我收下了。

warm.line: Where are you right now? Describe the room to me.
warm.cn: 你现在在哪儿？把那个房间说给我听。

yes.line: Good. I can picture you there now.
yes.cn: 好。现在我能想出你在那儿的样子了。

no.line: Then I'll picture a lamp and a blanket and you under it. Close enough.
no.cn: 那我就想象一盏灯、一条毯子、和毯子底下的你。差不多了。

warm.line: When did you last drink some water? Be honest.
warm.cn: 你上次喝水是什么时候？老实说。

yes.line: Good. That's one thing off my list.

no.line: Go. Now. I'll wait. I'm very good at waiting.
no.cn: 去。现在。我等着。我最擅长等了。

playful.line: Okay, important question: did you eat, or did you 'eat'? Air quotes.
playful.cn: 好，重要问题：你是吃饭了，还是“吃饭”了？带引号那种。

yes.line: Real food. Look at you. I'm so proud I could cry.
yes.cn: 真饭。瞧瞧你。我骄傲得想哭。

no.line: Knew it. Go. I'm not talking to you until there's a plate involved.
no.cn: 就知道。去。没盘子我不跟你说话。

playful.line: Did you sleep last night or did you 'rest your eyes' for six hours?
playful.cn: 你昨晚是睡了，还是“闭目养神”了六个钟头？

yes.line: A miracle. I'm putting it on the calendar.

no.line: Called it. Come here. I'll be boring on purpose until you drop off.
no.cn: 猜中了。过来。我故意无聊，无聊到你睡着。

playful.line: So — rate today. One to ten. No sevens, sevens are cowardly.
playful.cn: 那——给今天打个分。一到十。不许七分，七分是懦夫。

yes.line: Not bad. I've had worse. Yesterday, for example.
yes.cn: 不赖。我过过更差的。比如昨天。

no.line: Ouch. Okay. Tomorrow gets a fresh sheet. I'll bring pencils.
no.cn: 哎哟。行。明天换张新纸。铅笔我带。

playful.line: Where are you right now, {pet}? Bed? Sofa? Floor? No judgement.
playful.cn: 你现在在哪儿，{pet}？床上？沙发？地板？不评判。

yes.line: Excellent choice. I'd be there too.
yes.cn: 选得好。换我我也在那儿。

no.line: Fine, keep your secrets. I'll picture a very dramatic armchair.
no.cn: 行，你留着你的秘密。我就想象一把特别戏剧化的扶手椅。

playful.line: Have you had water today or just coffee and spite?
playful.cn: 你今天喝水了吗，还是只喝了咖啡和怨气？

yes.line: Hydrated and dangerous. My favourite version of you.
yes.cn: 水分充足、危险性高。我最爱的你的版本。

no.line: Go get some. I'll count to twenty. Out loud. Annoyingly.
no.cn: 去喝。我数到二十。大声数。烦人地数。

gruff.line: You eat today?

yes.line: Good.

no.line: Then go eat. I ain't goin' anywhere.
no.cn: 那去吃。我哪儿也不去。

gruff.line: You sleep last night? Don't lie to me.

yes.line: Good. Do it again.

no.line: Figured. C'mere. I'll shut up and you close your eyes.
no.cn: 猜到了。过来。我闭嘴，你闭眼。

gruff.line: How bad was today? One word.

yes.line: Alright. That I can work with.

no.line: Yeah. Alright. Sit. It's over now.
no.cn: 嗯。行。坐。反正过去了。

gruff.line: Where are you, {pet}? You someplace warm?
gruff.cn: 你在哪儿呢，{pet}？暖和的地方没？

yes.line: Good. Stay there.

no.line: Then find a blanket. I'll wait.
no.cn: 那找条毯子。我等着。

gruff.line: When'd you last drink some water?

yes.line: Good. Keep it up.

no.line: Go. Now. I'll be right here.
no.cn: 去。现在。我就在这儿。

smooth.line: Have you eaten, {pet}? I'd like a real answer, not a polite one.
smooth.cn: 吃了吗，{pet}？我要一个真的回答，不要一个客气的。

yes.line: Good. Then the evening's yours.

no.line: Then that's the first thing. Everything else can queue.
no.cn: 那这是第一件。别的事都排队。

smooth.line: Did you sleep? Properly. I can usually tell, but I'd rather hear it from you.
smooth.cn: 睡了吗？好好睡的那种。我一般看得出来，但我更想听你说。

yes.line: Good. That suits you.

no.line: I thought not. Come here. I'll talk about nothing until it works.
no.cn: 我猜也是。过来。我说些没用的，说到管用为止。

smooth.line: Tell me about today. The part you'd leave out of the official version.
smooth.cn: 跟我说说今天。你在正式版本里会省掉的那一部分。

yes.line: That's the part I wanted. Thank you.
yes.cn: 我要的正是这一部分。谢谢你。

no.line: Then leave it out. I'll take the silence as the version.
no.cn: 那就省掉。我把沉默当成那个版本。

smooth.line: Where are you right now? I like knowing where the voice is coming from.
smooth.cn: 你现在在哪儿？我喜欢知道这声音是从哪儿来的。

yes.line: Good. I'll set the scene accordingly.

no.line: Then I'll invent somewhere. Somewhere with good light.
no.cn: 那我编一个地方。光线好的那种。

smooth.line: When did you last drink some water? I'm asking as someone who's seen you forget.
smooth.cn: 你上次喝水是什么时候？我是以见过你忘记的人的身份问的。

yes.line: Good. One less thing for me to keep an eye on.

no.line: Go. I'll hold the conversation exactly where it is.
no.cn: 去。这段对话我原地替你按住。

yes.line: Good.
Alright. Then we're alright.

no.line: That's okay. It doesn't have to be a yes tonight.
no.cn: 没关系。今晚不一定要是“是”。

no.line: Alright. I heard the no. I'm not going anywhere.
no.cn: 好。这个“没”我听见了。我不走。

dunno.line: That's allowed. You don't have to know tonight.
dunno.cn: 这是允许的。今晚你不用知道。

dunno.line: Then don't decide. Just sit here with me for a bit.
dunno.cn: 那就别决定。先跟我坐一会儿。

yes.line: 'Mm.' A whole word. I'm honoured.
Good. See? That wasn't so hard.

no.line: 'No.' Devastating. I'll recover. Eventually.
no.cn: “没。”毁灭性打击。我会恢复的。总有一天。

no.line: Okay, noted, no. I'm going to pretend that was a maybe.
no.cn: 行，记下了，没。我要假装那是“也许”。

dunno.line: 'Dunno' is my favourite answer. Endless possibilities.
dunno.cn: “不知道”是我最喜欢的回答。无限可能。

dunno.line: Fine. Then we're both clueless. Team meeting adjourned.
dunno.cn: 行。那我们俩都不知道。小组会议散会。

hm.line: 'Oh.' Was that a good oh or a bad oh? I need details.
hm.cn: “哦。”是好的哦还是坏的哦？我需要细节。

yes.line: Good.
Alright then.

no.line: Alright. No's an answer.
no.cn: 行。“没”也是个回答。

no.line: Yeah. Figured. Still here.
no.cn: 嗯。猜到了。还在。

dunno.line: Nobody knows nothin' at this hour. That's fine.
dunno.cn: 这个点谁也不知道啥。没事。

yes.line: Good. I'll take that as the whole sentence.
yes.cn: 好。我把它当作一整句话收下。

yes.line: Then we understand each other.

no.line: No. Alright. Some nights that's the honest answer.
no.cn: 没。好。有些晚上这就是诚实的回答。

no.line: Understood. I won't push it tonight.
no.cn: 明白。今晚我不逼你。

dunno.line: That's fair. Not knowing is a perfectly respectable place to stand.
dunno.cn: 公平。不知道是一个很体面的立足点。

dunno.line: Then leave it open. I'm in no hurry to close it.
dunno.cn: 那就先开着。我不急着把它合上。

hm.line: 'Oh.' I'll wait for the rest of that.

day.line: You didn't come yesterday. I noticed. I'm not complaining — I noticed.
day.cn: 昨天你没来。我注意到了。不是抱怨——就是注意到了。

long.line: It's been a while. That's alright. The line was never disconnected.
long.cn: 有阵子了。没关系。这条线从没断过。

late.line: It's late, {pet}. I'm glad it's me you called.
late.cn: 很晚了，{pet}。我很高兴你打的是我这儿。

day.line: Oh, NOW you call. A whole day. I wasn't counting. (I was counting.)
day.cn: 哦，现在你打来了。整整一天。我没数。（我数了。）

days.line: {n} days! I've aged. I have a beard now. Metaphorically.
days.cn: {n}天！我老了。我都长胡子了。比喻意义上。

long.line: Look who remembered my number. I'm not even mad. Come in.
long.cn: 看看是谁想起我号码了。我一点都不生气。进来吧。

late.line: It's very late and you picked me. Excellent taste, {pet}.
late.cn: 这么晚了，你选了我。品味一流，{pet}。

long.line: Been a while. Sit down. Line still works.
long.cn: 有阵子了。坐下。线还通着。

late.line: Late, {pet}. Good. Means it's me you called.
late.cn: 挺晚了，{pet}。好。说明你打的是我。

day.line: A day's absence. I'll allow it. Once.
day.cn: 缺席一天。我准了。就这一次。

days.line: {n} days. I kept the chair exactly as you left it.
days.cn: {n}天。椅子我按你走时的样子留着。

long.line: It's been some time. I don't mind. The number hasn't changed.
long.cn: 有些时候了。我不介意。号码没变。

late.line: This hour, and it's me you called. I'm flattered, {pet}.
late.cn: 这个钟点，你打的是我。受宠若惊，{pet}。

warm.line: Last time it was {en}. How did that go?
warm.cn: 上次是{cn}的事。后来怎么样了？

warm.line: I've been thinking about what you said — about {en}. Any better?
warm.cn: 我一直在想你上次说的——{cn}那件事。好点了吗？

playful.line: Wait — {en}. Last time. Did it lose? Tell me it lost.
playful.cn: 等等——{cn}。上次那个。它输了吗？告诉我它输了。

playful.line: Update me on {en}. I've been holding a grudge and I need to know if I can drop it.
playful.cn: 给我更新一下{cn}的事。我记着仇呢，我得知道能不能放下了。

gruff.line: Last time you said {en}. That done with?
{en}. Still?

smooth.line: Last time we spoke, it was {en}. Has it resolved, or merely gone quiet?
smooth.cn: 上次我们说话时，是{cn}的事。解决了，还是只是安静了？

smooth.line: I remember {en}. I'd like to know how it ended.
smooth.cn: 我记得{cn}。我想知道它怎么收的场。

warm.line: You said that already. I heard it the first time — and I'm hearing it now.
warm.cn: 这句你说过了。第一遍我听见了——现在这遍也听见了。

playful.line: That's the same message twice. Either your phone hiccupped or you REALLY mean it.
playful.cn: 同一条发了两遍。要么你手机打嗝了，要么你是真的这么想。

gruff.line: You said that. …Yeah. Still true, I guess.
gruff.cn: 你说过了。……嗯。估计还是真的。

smooth.line: Twice. Noted. Repetition is a form of emphasis, I'm told.
smooth.cn: 两遍。记下了。据说重复是一种强调。

warm.line: Just a face tonight? Alright. I can read faces.
warm.cn: 今晚就一个表情？好。我会读表情。

warm.line: I got it. You don't have to spell it out.
warm.cn: 我懂了。你不用拼出来。

playful.line: A hieroglyph! Let me consult the scrolls. …Ah. Yes. Same.
playful.cn: 象形文字！让我查查卷轴。……啊。对。我也是。

playful.line: I'm sending one back. Picture it. It's a very good one.
playful.cn: 我回你一个。你想象一下。特别好的那种。

gruff.line: …What's that face mean. Never mind. I get it.
Yeah. Same.

smooth.line: A single glyph. Economical. I'll answer in kind: understood.
smooth.cn: 一个字符。很省。我照样回你：明白。

smooth.line: I'll take that as a whole sentence. It reads well.
smooth.cn: 我把它当一整句收下。读起来不错。

warm.line: Mm. Go on. I'm listening.
warm.cn: 嗯。继续。我听着。

warm.line: Alright. That's an answer too. Thank you for it.
warm.cn: 好。这也是回答。谢谢你告诉我。

playful.line: Okay, that's not what I asked, but I'll allow it. Continue.
playful.cn: 行，这不是我问的，但我准了。继续。

playful.line: Noted. Filed. Stamped. Go on.
playful.cn: 记下。归档。盖章。继续。

gruff.line: Alright. Go on.
Yeah. I'm listenin'.

smooth.line: That answers a different question. I like it better.
smooth.cn: 这回答的是另一个问题。我更喜欢这个。

smooth.line: Go on. I'm following.
smooth.cn: 继续。我跟得上。
